Peter, When you hold public office in a democracy, you can’t hide from the voters. Our system of government was created by the founders to be _of the people, by the people, and for the people_. Whether or not someone voted for you, every elected official should listen to their constituents’ hopes and dreams, and their struggles. Because listening to people and building relationships and understanding our common goals is the best way to bring some of them along with you. These days, that’s not what’s happening. With the midterm elections approaching, Donald Trump and the Republican party aren’t trying to persuade voters to see things their way — they’re trying to sidestep them altogether. Republicans know their policies are deeply unpopular, so they are rewriting the rules to try to rig the outcome of the midterms before voters can even weigh in. They would rather manipulate maps to lock in their power than change their policies in response to their constituents. Let’s be clear: This isn’t how our democracy is supposed to work. **Attorney General Eric Holder and I started the NDRC so the people would have more power to shape the future of our country — and right now, we're doing everything we can to preserve our democracy so we can ultimately make it stronger and fairer.[Can we count on you to support this mission with a donation right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124104005/597591096/-487148479?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_JanuaryObama_email_20260127-NDRC-Tier1-JanuaryObama_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260127-NDRC-Tier1-JanuaryObama_&utm_campaign=JanuaryObama&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3NGNkMTdhLTgxZmItZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TCrtmtwZdKZYUfNlRSUd9MiYSC75X2Gk15j4oxL4yeA=)** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

The latest redistricting crisis started last summer when the White House persuaded Texas lawmakers to redraw the state's congressional map by dismantling districts where voters of color had been able to elect their candidate of choice. Missouri and North Carolina joined in, manipulating their own maps to try to steal enough seats to maintain control of the House of Representatives in the 2026 election.
And this fight is just beginning. At the start of this new year, several state legislatures are thinking about redrawing their maps to benefit Republicans. Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis announced the legislature would hold a special session this spring to make its current gerrymander even worse.
It’s on people like us to fight for fairness and to ensure that politicians are accountable to the people they were elected to serve.

### **Recommendation - SUPPORT**
**HB847:** This bill creates a Health Care Facility Right to Visit Act that guarantees patients in licensed health facilities the ability to receive visitors, including during public health emergencies, while granting facilities immunity from liability for complying.
### **Full Analysis**
_A vote for this bill is a vote to protect patients and families from blanket visitation bans by hospitals and similar facilities, even during emergencies, while shielding those facilities from lawsuits for following these visitation protections._
#### **Key Provisions & Tradeoffs**
* Prohibits licensed or certificate-of-need health care facilities from adopting policies that limit patient visitation by designated family or friends for stays over 24 hours, including during declared public health emergencies.
* Requires facilities to allow at least two designated visitors for at least two hours per day, while still allowing facilities to impose reasonable safety requirements on visitation.
* Grants health care facilities immunity from damages in liability actions arising from their compliance with the act, in addition to any existing immunities.

#### **Liberty Analysis**
This bill is a response to the sweeping visitation bans seen during COVID-era emergency policies. It limits both state-driven and facility-driven overreach by creating a baseline right for patients in regulated health facilities to receive visits from family or friends, including during declared public health emergencies. From a civil liberties and human dignity standpoint, it curtails the ability of health bureaucracies and facilities to isolate individuals in long hospital or long-term care stays, reinforcing that emergency powers must still respect basic human and family contact.

From a limited-government perspective, the bill cuts in two directions. On one hand, it is a state mandate on private and quasi-private facilities, specifying minimum visitation access and hours, which is a regulatory constraint on how those businesses operate. On the other hand, that mandate operates as a restriction on both government and corporate power to impose draconian lockdown-style visitation bans. Given the recent history of very heavy-handed state and facility restrictions that severely harmed patients and families, the net direction here is pro-liberty: it constrains emergency powers and bureaucratic discretion in favor of individual and family rights.

Economically, the bill does not create new spending, agencies, or enforcement structures, and it explicitly reduces legal exposure for facilities by granting them immunity when they comply with this visitation-rights framework. There may be marginal compliance and operational costs to manage visitation under various safety protocols, but these are modest and largely operational, not major fiscal burdens. The added immunity also somewhat offsets liability risk that could otherwise encourage excessive restriction. Overall, it modestly improves liberty by codifying a baseline right to visitation and limiting the ability of both state and institutional actors to use emergencies as a pretext for extreme isolation policies, without expanding spending or taxation.

| While our short-term sights are set on the upcoming Primary Elections, it’s time to start getting prepped for the **Republican Party of Texas Convention!** Though this huge gathering does not take place until early June in Houston, the groundwork is laid at the **Precinct and Senate District/County Conventions** , which take place in March. Today you have a very special chance

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5dh4pq3hamr0503to4nlinbnkaesp3gl3v1tae8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4slj61or2cdh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbelu552cjemuuidr8pobupc60i192e4fmg0ob3g_rp22sh2s8i6eor4slj61or2cdh2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdjof1stdufkh95k7066an3c8f52ran32rah96po_rp22sh2s8i6eor4slj61or2cdh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu513nr1hqt22b72g281jflptovjaip933d6pcko_rp22sh2s8i6eor4slj61or2cdh2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcdgc6lro33thbmju0hhrigdg4sbp881qv1mqbpg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4slj61or2cdh2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,

name: Brian Lenney
subject: Idaho HAS to cut spending.
body:
Programs, budgets, services. All of it.

| |
---|---|---
|
# Idaho HAS to cut spending.
### Programs, budgets, services. All of it.
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Jan 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
You've seen the news...
We're upside down financially and have a constitutional MANDATE to balance the budget.
But you want to know what I'd rather _**not do**_? Strip assistance from people with disabilities. From kids who need it. That's what I'd rather _**not do**_.
But the multibillion dollar education budget is "untouchable." The Governor said so himself. Which means everything else is fair game because the money simply isn't there. We can't keep everything afloat.
So here come the cuts.
I've been beating this drum for years. Others have too. And now we're here. Finally here. You know how we got here?
_**Overspending.**_
_**Year after year after year of overspending.**_
So when someone asks why we're likely going to be taking services away from vulnerable people while refusing to touch education funding?
That's why.
Because when you protect one thing (well, it's way more than just ONE thing being "protected") everything else has to bleed for it. That's the reality. And that's what happens when you run out of money but refuse to make the hard calls.
Cheers,

# **First Lady Melania Trump calls for unity amid Minneapolis tensions**
First lady Melania Trump **[called for national unity Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/0c1eb1b9-386c-47ec-9526-1633780fff10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as tensions remain high following the fatal shootings of two civilians by federal agents in Minneapolis, saying "We need to unify" and noting President Trump had "a great call yesterday with the governor [Tim Walz] and the mayor [Jacob Frey], and they're working together to make it peaceful and without riots," while urging "I'm against violence so, please, if you protest, protest in peace."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c1eb1b9-386c-47ec-9526-1633780fff10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Mrs. Trump offers compassion for winter storm victims:** Mrs. Trump offered comforting words to Americans reeling from the effects of a massive winter storm that slammed several states, saying "I feel deep compassion for the people who are impacted by this storm. I know the federal government is working hard to provide assistance to all who need it. As Americans, we need to help each other and come together in these difficult times."
* **First Lady promotes upcoming "MELANIA" film ahead of Friday launch:** The first lady joined "Fox & Friends" live from the White House to promote her upcoming 104-minute movie "MELANIA" ahead of its global launch on Friday, which shares her life leading up to President Trump's inauguration as 47th president, with Mrs. Trump telling Ainsley Earhardt "This story was never told before, so the audience will see me--how I manage my business, my philanthropy, family preparation for the inauguration and also establishing the East Wing for the White House--how I manage all of that in 20 days prior to the inauguration."

# **Kristi Noem demands crisis meeting after being sidelined on Minneapolis response**
Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem **[demanded a two-hour meeting with President Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/e587f131-de58-418d-ba62-1d3bb914db7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the Oval Office late Monday after she was elbowed aside amid backlash over her handling of the latest deadly shooting in Minneapolis, with Trump holding crisis talks with Noem and top aides after he revealed border czar Tom Homan was headed to take charge of DHS efforts in Minneapolis following Alex Pretti's killing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e587f131-de58-418d-ba62-1d3bb914db7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Noem faces criticism for branding Pretti "domestic terrorist":** Noem has faced widespread criticism after she was quick to brand Pretti a "domestic terrorist" who had charged at officers while brandishing a gun, but numerous videos instead showed the ICU nurse only holding a cellphone and trying to get away from the agents, sparking immediate questions about Trump's faith in Noem's handling of the ongoing immigration crackdown, though Trump didn't suggest Noem's job was on the line during the sit-down.
* **Border Patrol chief Bovino ordered to retreat from Minnesota:** Separately, Border Patrol chief Greg Bovino and some of his agents were ordered Monday to start retreating from Minnesota, with Bovino--known for his no-holds-barred approach to immigration enforcement--slammed for falsely claiming Pretti was brandishing a gun and had "wanted to do maximum damage and massacre law enforcement."
* **Trump administration denies Bovino demotion reports:** The Trump administration denied reports Bovino had been demoted as a result of the Minneapolis fallout, with DHS Assistant Secretary Tricia McLaughlin posting on X that "Chief Gregory Bovino has NOT been relieved of his duties," adding he was a "key part of the president's team and a great American."

# **CIA Director Ratcliffe emerges as Trump 's "quiet hammer"**
CIA Director John Ratcliffe has become President Donald Trump's go-to operative for high-stakes missions, with a White House source **[telling Breitbart News](https://substack.com/redirect/085dd99a-dee0-4569-b4db-ee571252c759?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "He goes in, accomplishes whatever mission the President gave him, then disappears back into the shadows," pointing to how Trump sent Ratcliffe to Venezuela just 12 days after Maduro's capture to meet with acting president Delcy Rodriguez as Trump's first Cabinet-level official to visit since the operation.
* **Ratcliffe dismantles DEI, refocuses CIA on mission and asset recruitment:** Ratcliffe has totally dismantled all Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion programs at the CIA and returned the Agency to a merit-based culture while dramatically increasing CIA asset recruitment numbers--which had dwindled under previous directors like John Brennan--keeping a classified chart on his desk tracking these metrics as "the scorecard" for whether "we're recruiting assets" and "stealing our adversaries' secrets," including successful Mandarin-language recruitment videos targeting Chinese officials.
* **CIA integral to major Trump operations including Maduro capture, Iran strikes:** Under Ratcliffe's leadership, the CIA has been instrumental in several major operations including Operation Absolute Resolve (Maduro's capture), Operation Midnight Hammer (U.S. airstrikes that wiped out Iran's nuclear program), and the capture of Abbey Gate bombing mastermind "Jafar" in Pakistan, with Ratcliffe saying the Jafar capture "sent an early message that President Trump was shifting the paradigm all over the world" and "reestablished American credibility."

The new Utah 1st Congressional District encapsulates the bluest precincts of Salt Lake County. Attorney and commentator [Andrew F. Branca](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e8fe3cc9-961c-4675-916c-eebcb54020ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (@TheBrancaShow), who provides pro-America, pro-Constitution, pro-Western civilization political and legal analysis, has said "One of the many ways the US immigration system has become corrupted is that our immigration judges are drawn from the ranks of immigration lawyers, who are ADVOCATES for third-world migrant clients."
In his X [posted on December 18, 2025](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4e175f89-8d6a-4b35-b986-3d49467f75d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), raising concerns about several lifetime-appointed Article III federal judges who are naturalized U.S. citizens born outside the country.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.-JVq6nPeIl6cVRDmkys-5EBfP8YnX9e26YbqRcKc2uc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=185910471)
Branca argues that these judges, all appointed by Democratic presidents (Barack Obama or Joe Biden), lack full allegiance to American values and are disproportionately concentrated in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia (D.C. Circuit). He highlights their involvement in what he calls "lawfare" against President-elect Donald Trump, portraying it as an assault on the democratic will of the American people.
Branca lists five specific judges, emphasizing their foreign birthplaces and appointments:
\- Ana Cecilia Reyes: Born in Uruguay, appointed by Biden in 2023. Branca notes she serves in the D.C. Circuit.
\- Amir Ali Mehta: Born in Canada to Egyptian migrant parents, appointed by Biden in 2024. Branca claims Mehta retains Canadian citizenship, questioning his cultural ties to America, and places him in the D.C. Circuit.
\- Sparkle Sooknanan: Born in Trinidad, appointed by Biden and confirmed on January 2, 2025. According to Branca, she maintains dual citizenship with Trinidad and also sits in the D.C. Circuit.
\- Tanya Chutkan: Born in Jamaica, appointed by Obama in 2014, serving in the D.C. Circuit.
\- Amit Priyavadan Mehta: Born in India, appointed by Obama in 2014, also in the D.C. Circuit.
Mr. Branca stresses that no Republican president has ever appointed a non-natural-born citizen to the federal bench, implying a partisan pattern. He points out that some of these judges hold dual citizenship, which he sees as evidence of divided loyalties.
Most alarmingly, he notes that the D.C. Circuit, with only 15 judges (representing just 2% of all federal district judges), employs all five of these naturalized judges--making up one-third of its bench. Yet, this court has handled 30% of legal actions against Trump, including temporary restraining orders and preliminary injunctions.
Branca questions the integrity of these judges' naturalization processes, suggesting a thorough re-examination of their visas, green cards, and citizenship applications for potential fraud or deception. He implies their foreign backgrounds may influence their rulings, eroding American sovereignty and judicial impartiality.
The federal judge overseeing the 15 judges of the D.C. Circuit is [Chief Judge James E. Boasberg](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e4005402-060e-4778-aee2-4710533b6bc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Himself under administrative scrutiny judicial in nature, stemming from controversies over his rulings in cases involving the Trump administration's immigration policies, past handling of FISA warrants, and alleged involvement in investigations related to January 6 and Trump associates.
In July 2025, the Department of Justice (under Attorney General Pam Bondi) filed a formal misconduct complaint against Boasberg. It accused him of making "[improper public comments](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1724288a-19ea-4b10-b5b9-1861bec98c0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" about President Trump and his administration during a private Judicial Conference meeting in March 2025, allegedly undermining judicial impartiality and public confidence in the judiciary. The complaint sought investigation, potential reprimand, case reassignment, and possible referral for further discipline (including impeachment consideration).
Multiple Republican members of Congress have introduced resolutions to impeach or remove Boasberg with H.Res. 229 and H.Res. 270 (early 2025): Alleged interference with presidential prerogatives and failure to maintain "good behavior" under Article III, primarily over rulings blocking aspects of Trump administration deportation policies under the Alien Enemies Act.
Away from the bench, [Katharine Boasberg](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9d6e36c8-d9eb-4c7b-ad04-f56d239cceeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (one of his twin daughters), works for a nonprofit organization called [Partners for Justice](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5d170b78-c752-45b2-8a98-cbb9ed5f0690?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (PFJ). She is employed as a "capacity building associate," a role involving coordinating grant activities, ensuring compliance, and supporting programs to strengthen public defender offices and provide support services in criminal defense cases.
This connection became a point of controversy in early 2025 amid Judge Boasberg's rulings on Trump administration deportation policies, with critics alleging a potential conflict of interest due to the nonprofit's pro-immigrant stance, opposition to certain immigration enforcement laws (e.g., the Laken Riley Act), and receipt of significant government funding (over $3.3 million in grants in 2023, about half its revenue).
Partners for Justice (PFJ), a nonprofit focused on supporting public defender offices and holistic defense (including social services for defendants, some of whom may be immigrants). PFJ's founder, [Emily Galvin-Almanza](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/269f773a-d651-46a9-bea3-3b6e56355a7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has publicly opposed certain Trump-era immigration policies, such as the Laken Riley Act (calling it "horrible" and "cruel") and praised Judge Boasberg's 2025 rulings blocking deportations under the Alien Enemies Act.
The same day as Branca's post, Milwaukee County Circuit Court [Judge Hannah Dugan](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9724bdf9-91f5-4087-b598-8103315d47e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was convicted by a federal jury in Milwaukee of one felony count of obstructing or impeding an official proceeding before a U.S. department or agency (related to federal immigration enforcement) [for helping illegal immigrants evade ICE arrest](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5c1b84f4-0164-468b-8bcb-31efdfdd2834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Dugan, a judge since 2016, had been suspended from duties by the Wisconsin Supreme Court pending the case. The felony conviction likely disqualifies her from holding judicial office under the Wisconsin Constitution.
The case drew national attention as part of broader tensions over immigration enforcement in courthouses during the Trump administration's policies. Some viewed it as a necessary accountability measure, while others raised concerns about judicial independence.
Overall, Branca's critique of judicial appointments, blending factual details on judges' backgrounds with pointed political commentary on immigration, citizenship, and perceived threats to U.S. institutions makes the compelling case the D.C. Circuit, like the Milwaukee County Circuit are compromised by foreign interest above American justice.
_Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer._

#
Ladies and Gentlemen, this is Paul Eaton.
My friend, Alex Vindman, is running for a seat in the United States Senate in my home state of Florida.
And today, I am humbly asking you to make a contribution to his campaign. If you’re ready, use this link:
**[https://act.votevets.org/go/alex-vindman](https://act.votevets.org/go/alex-vindman?t=1&akid=34902%2E3013755%2EpZcaVb)**
While I was in the Army, I commanded the U.S. Army Infantry Center at Fort Benning. Alex is a graduate of our most elite Infantry schools, including Ranger School, Airborne and our finest leadership schools; and he was commissioned as an Infantry officer. He led American troops in combat, was wounded in action, and received the Purple Heart.
This alone is a record of service and sacrifice worthy of recognition, but it’s likely you know of Alex for a different reason. In 2019, while serving on the National Security Council, Alex blew the whistle on a phone call in which Donald Trump asked President Zelenskyy of Ukraine to investigate the Biden family in exchange for military aid.
Trump went on to be impeached for that phone call, and that happened because Alex had the courage to do the right thing. For his courage, Alex has had to endure relentless attacks from Trump, his allies, and their extremist supporters. But it has not broken him, nor has it lessened his love for and devotion to this country.
I can personally attest to that. I have been incredibly fortunate to work with Alex for the last several years at VoteVets. I have personally witnessed his integrity, his intelligence, and his patriotism. At this perilous time in our nation’s history, I’m incredibly proud that Alex has chosen to serve - again.
I can tell you this with absolute certainty: If more people like Alex ran for office we’d be well on our way to saving this country from the likes of Trump. We need more people like him in the Senate.
[**And on behalf of VoteVets, I am humbly asking you to make a generous donation to his campaign for Senate. Florida is one of the toughest states in the country, but Alex can win. subject: Affordable Medicine Advocacy Day Was A Success!
body:
| | |

| Friends-
Last week, we met at the General Assembly to advocate for the Affordable Medicine Act, which would create a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia as well as implement the prices for medications that were negotiated by Medicare as a part of the Inflation Reduction Act. 1 in 4 Virginians chooses not to take their prescription medications simply because they cannot afford them, and it's time that we take action so that Virginians never have to choose between taking life-saving prescription drugs and providing for their families.
---
| |
---
Meeting with Delegate Laura Jane Cohen (House District 15)
---
| |
---
| Meeting with Senator David Marsden (Senate District 35)
---
| |

Meeting with Delegate Kelly Convirs-Fowler (House District 96)
---
| |
---
Meeting with Delegate Alex Askew (House District 95)
---
| |
---
Meeting with Delegate JJ Singh (House District 26)
We thank all of the legislators who met with us and listened as we advocated for a Prescription Drug Affordability Board and THANK YOU to the incredible Virginians who came with us and shared their stories about prescription drug affordability. Because of your support, we were able to meet with over 10 legislators' offices and continue fighting for an affordable Virginia.

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gqhUS2o3EEqwOQNv6xUYZAO5AVipQInjPEcGPD65Hk2jwaM3TXTO56O9SWcaXRqp0O43sKi6mq1MLVmpPBjLdU0taGFYe242nqIhYR_jy4tCIXYo2wWmU1PO8ggkybU4dx85OcEmgJSrn9d2pyvV31UWd-w0gldTIqAGG791sIDZlZuATPqg32Akqkoq4OKRj3xiJW8KFbN44tfw_r8zBVihuk6-9OlGvVxGg5Rozt0=&c=5tDjHfbLwbF-eFMuuuOgni9jnrEGk2O5ormZ0DCcVLeLdaDoE90SMw==&ch=xOE-48JZyZ_TJRc4902gLHmdWDfzEs0PsNrH65vPUgOZOCZznw9x2A==)

| Peter,
Minneapolis is not alone in this fight for our democracy.
In the wake of the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, and after Attorney General Pam Bondi all but admitted that the ICE invasion is being used to extort Minnesota into handing over voter records, one thing is now painfully clear: this was never just about immigration.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gqhUS2o3EEqwOQNv6xUYZAO5AVipQInjPEcGPD65Hk2jwaM3TXTO56O9SWcaXRqp0O43sKi6mq1MLVmpPBjLdU0taGFYe242nqIhYR_jy4tCIXYo2wWmU1PO8ggkybU4dx85OcEmgJSrn9d2pyvV31UWd-w0gldTIqAGG791sIDZlZuATPqg32Akqkoq4OKRj3xiJW8KFbN44tfw_r8zBVihuk6-9OlG5jap6UaFwug=&c=5tDjHfbLwbF-eFMuuuOgni9jnrEGk2O5ormZ0DCcVLeLdaDoE90SMw==&ch=xOE-48JZyZ_TJRc4902gLHmdWDfzEs0PsNrH65vPUgOZOCZznw9x2A==)
---
Trump is using ICE as part of an all-out assault on our democracy.
Many of the states now facing ICE invasions are the very states where Defend Our Courts plans to protect, expand, or build pro-democracy Supreme Court majorities--the courts that ultimately decide election cases and determine whether abuse of power is stopped or allowed to continue.
Here's what we're seeing:

* Kentucky: ICE arrests surged by more than 37% in early 2025. Local law enforcement agencies and county jails are increasingly entangled with ICE enforcement.

* Montana: ICE operations have expanded statewide, with multiple high-profile detentions and arrests.

* Nevada: Arrests are surging in Reno and Las Vegas, and the governor authorized National Guard support for ICE.

* Georgia: The state now ranks fourth nationally in ICE arrests, with National Guard support deployed.

* Michigan: Targeted enforcement surges are underway as part of broader Midwest operations.

* Minnesota: Nearly 2,700 ICE agents have been deployed as part of "Operation Metro Surge."

* North Carolina: A high number of local law enforcement agencies now participate directly in ICE programs.

* Ohio: Enforcement activity has increased, with National Guard support authorized.

* Texas: Over 24,000 people entered ICE custody in just two months during 2025.

* Wisconsin and Kansas: Both are included in expanded Midwestern ICE operations.

It's no coincidence.
MAGA knows elections are run by states, not the federal government. That's why they are pressuring governors, intimidating state officials, and demanding voter records. And that's why state Supreme Courts are now the last line of defense.
With strong, independent, pro-democracy state courts, we can block election interference, protect voter privacy, and hold those who commit brutality on our streets accountable, beyond the reach of presidential pardons.
In 2025, because of supporters like you, we proved this works when we successfully defended the Democrat majority on Pennsylvania's Supreme Court.
As ICE violence ratchets up, so do the stakes.
Protecting our constitutional rights. Holding abusers of power accountable. Stopping a MAGA election rigging.
That is our mission. And we cannot do it without you.

name: Barlow For Wyo
subject: Barlow For Wyoming Newsletter
body:
Headed South Soon, But The Work Doesn't Stop
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFZYMAQB0Z8JCRC9YBBE96S1_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Headed South Soon, but the Work Doesn't Stop!
---
| Hi friends, As we move toward the upcoming legislative session in February, my focus remains on doing the work Wyoming people expect, as a Senator, and with this campaign to be your next Governor. That work includes advancing constituent-driven legislation, including a stem cell bill centered on a patient's 'right to try' with access and clear safeguards, a 'move over' bill to increase safety for roadside service and tire repair vehicle, standing up for Wyoming’s oil and gas industry and the jobs it supports, and promoting thoughtful, balanced conversations about the state budget. I'll be less able to travel during the session, which makes me grateful to have a great team of supporters and volunteers forwarding the campaign goals and efforts in tandem. There is no time to waste, and Kelly and I sincerely thank you.

As the race continues to ramp up, we’ll need continued help getting our "Barlow Effect' message out across the state. That means humble requests for financial support for signs, advertising, and events. And just as importantly, it means people talking with neighbors, hosting small gatherings, and inviting others to learn more about what we’re building together. If you’re willing to help in any of those ways, we’d be grateful to have you 'Riding for Wyoming' with us through those efforts. \- Eric
---
| **Ride with Barlow for Wyoming**
---
| Eric's campaign is powered by folks who believe in Wyoming’s values of hard work, integrity, and community. Your contribution keeps us moving forward to build a stronger future for our state. **👉 Join the ride — chip in today!**
---
| | [ DONATE ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFZYMAQB0Z8JCRC9YBBE96S1_1)
---
|
---
| | | **BOARD of EQUALIZATION DECISION** The decision this past week to stop the Wyoming State Board of Equalization (BOE) from moving forward with a lawsuit was a good decision.
The Legislature took a targeted and measured approach to protect citizens in 2024 with the 4% cap on residential property tax increases. If there are concerns, we need to review them thoughtfully. In the meantime, my focus remains on ensuring Wyoming’s property tax system is fair, predictable, and constitutionally sound, so families and landowners aren’t caught off guard by sudden increases.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| |
---
| **TEAM BARLOW** Last week I announced a statewide leadership team that represents the heart of Wyoming-ranchers, small-business owners, energy workers, educators, parents, veterans, young professionals and community leaders who believe deeply in the future of our state. Each brings firsthand knowledge of their communities and a commitment to ensuring that Wyoming's next chapter is built by the people who call this place home.
Their leadership will help guide this campaign the same way Wyoming people make decisions every day: by listening first, understanding the needs of our communities, and working together to get things done. The team is led by Diana Enzi and Tony Ross, and includes a growing list of engaged Wyomingites, including: Brad and Jan Cundy, Frank and Elaine Moore, John Robitaille, and Fred and Susie von Ahrens.
The leadership team will support county-level organizing and help ensure the campaign continues to reflect the voices of Wyoming's people.
---
|
---
| | | YAY - SIGNS!!

CAN YOU HELP WITH THE NEXT ORDER??
You've all been patient, and FINALLY, the Barlow for Governor signs are starting to appear across the Wyoming landscape, with strong backing for the Wyoming wind and weather! Many of you have asked for smaller yard signs, which will arrive for distribution this spring.
But, as you know...we have A LOT of land to cover. Can you help with an additional donation to keep the sign printer moving? Click the link below!
---
| | |
---
| | [ HELP WITH SIGN COSTS! ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFZYMAQB0Z8JCRC9YBBE96S1_2)
---
|
---
| | | REEL-Y?
If you're on social media, you might have noticed some additional video shorts, or Reels, have surfaced on Facebook and Instagram. Our following is growing through this effort, especially among our younger voters! Reels are meant to be engaging and drive traffic to our website and message. Have a look!
---
| | |
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| |
---
| **CASPER** This week I attended the Oil City Conservative Group meeting in Casper, where I was asked to speak at their dinner event.
I shared my gratitude to the industry, saying “Oil and gas workers power this community, this state, and this nation; and I appreciate what you do every single day.”
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| JACKSON It was my pleasure to speak at the Association of General Contractors' Annual Convention last week in Jackson, and I was in good company, speaking on a Legislative update panel with Representatives Lloyd Larsen, Andrew Byron, and Cody Wylie. ACG Executive Director Dan Benford and Government Affairs Director Kelli Little were great hosts and excellent advocates for our Wyoming Contractors!.
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| ROCK SPRINGS Kelly and I spent last night at the 11th annual Kari’s Access Awards, which raises funds for non-traditional scholarships for students in Sweetwater County District #1. It was a pleasure to see how this community turned out to support the effort! We are pictured with the wonderful Larry Fusselman, who started the project in honor of his late daughter Kari. This event is all about opening doors and creating life-changing opportunities for local kids who need them most.
---
|
---
| **Get In The Saddle**
---
| | |
---
| | | | Wyoming’s strength has always come from neighbors pitching in. Join the Barlow For Wyoming team of volunteers who are helping share his message across our state. **🤠 Ride with us — sign up to volunteer!**
---
| | [ VOLUNTEER ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFZYMAQB0Z8JCRC9YBBE96S1_3)
---
| | | | **Follow Us Online**
---

Folks might've killed to have my job.
I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:
I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative.
So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. [](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/AnJrQwPylznDIdBBYxmsCA-XLrMehYNbngymAJ8XO0W_aOEy1b6x1EZlilW-JgQj81ntR3OtdoAkNP55Ghgw8QsRpJwwMnI3DVMK9qNPMguemcKRlJ1x6ZIYm_BBoZUT8A8HRPRdQMkVtu3W1zJJRf6HwYjlRAdZtwa5WxPix3_BVJGMG36Syyf0XAWfcEc3XDO7HboOOCYRqQctkdYDUzvaeoKv6Z5rHZQN8IKKUhJADoeibYJBYaJNUi6v_q3Qky-CN6WFFlwI1krMGUN4V0_N5_1CpDtuA-erldjnk1yiuTW_dTRd1wDwnGPnKGWBEAMW9Xt4XhcAtYY-P_WUKeIxBQe4u-qOgGbKHiQhojplXToYiyfGOH8gmFSPkX4s1Sn9TdWTxDQ-Ui6uXDY2hPI0ELkUSYxIhoiqGLjTFiQTTzefJq5Xlr_kC7ln1dW5JKaKy328mqGuuD-6AdNMFQ40psbmovKhmZ55Jdyj1OEvbdBgwtg4Gqc65k1pyeDwUbCu8r12_1J-dHTnWwphJ33M5mL7C7sVHHS_DO1am5qhbnW6db4X2s2cwngVYYstn_Lk7Glpy7U7KOAxIsTx2ED9MvPSHhtvJkJk8t-OHfxnO8gWnNVwnbkrMbqiqyEQmMsHpY9fCWZeKEOeSI9x0Rl0LhYlsbJZ9oVVPRFhMSwqISV-bbcpEtGT_Pi4BW-OuCoWpXoTA9O0tIs71DHq5qi38VoJKeEjyiUXVfb0ujQMhadCYlBx/krfSavS1xvC8ybQ4YLRu-fFuLS8Hx3QJ/17)It was the hardest decision I've ever made. **Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. **
**My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in 10,000 founding donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our first advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. **

clean_body: Michele Tafoya here. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. there Peter, I hope you are well! Folks might've killed to have my job. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary. I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem: I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative. So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that 's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who 's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I 'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in 10,000 founding donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our first advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I 'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. I 'm committing my blood, sweat, and tears to take this seat back from the political class. I 'd be honored if you'd be willing to stand alongside me. Donations in these early days make the biggest impact on our path to victory. I hope you 'll join us, but either way, God bless you! Be brave. Do good. - Michele TafoyaRepublican for Senate, Minnesota official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! subject: The Guzman Gazette vol. 2

body:
| | | I hope everyone is staying inside and warm during this winter weather storm. The Virginia Department of Transportation continues to do a great job clearing roads and ensuring Virginians can go about their daily routines as soon as possible. _Stay tuned for more updates._ I drove to Richmond (1/26) yesterday and I am happy to report that I-95 southbound is clear and safe to drive. ******Please continue to stay home if you don’t need to drive!**
* * *
**We had a very busy second week of the legislative session, and I am excited to share with you what was accomplished.** This week started with the new Governor, Abigail Spanberger addressing a joint session of the General Assembly, outlining her vision to create a safer, stronger, and more affordable Commonwealth. **We had two bills pass out of subcommittees this week, HB 414 and HB 496.** ******HB 414** is a bill to remove the Selective Service question from state financial aid. This bipartisan bill cleans up the state code to align with federal law and can save Virginia students up to $5,250 a year. This bill passed unanimously out of both the subcommittee (6-0) and the Appropriations Committee (22-0). It is currently on its Third Reading. This is a huge step toward making sure Virginia stays academically competitive and making state financial aid more accessible. [**Click here to view the subcommittee hearing**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg46IArW3BRYtqJEVQiNUeIRjfKIgxWzTE_136mYiwl0YK6Esr2sfMfAUOoRTWborePQ0VTZNFn1qNhusxP38BU8f1SVanexuJoqjaDi6NEyXUZCBtE9uw1l-bdLmRw0v8W_hOi268_rC81v9EyG3Tr7gB4Dc8iFEdPCIL-1cXLTQTiSQqHhRCF2EI2DXKsNKAouKs1v7ZmuxrUOiHMr8GC3tp59PWWiHw1iEkmQBci0GeKOOw_Ys1DATwJzVFNeTwhesAlNtyMECGYT5pyYYJ1_D/4nn/hm-2lL6BQGSCxTUYyKGvtg/h0/h001.-qCPc0gaUPz4kWgt0Xo44qLJ8fNuBOZIG2Hqhh_USso)**.** **HB 496** requires data centers to disclose their expected water use for operations. This bill is a win for government transparency and allows localities to plan ahead for water resource allocation and conservation. It passed out of Subcommittee #3 on Friday on a vote of 6-1. Thank you to Friends of Rappahannock, National Parks Conservation Association, Virginia Farm Bureau, League of Conservation, James River Association, Virginia Conservation Network, Virginia Interfaith Power and Light, Virginia Coalition for Open Government, Southern Environmental Law Center, Potomac Rivers Network, Coalition for Smarter Growth, Piedmont Environmental Council, and the members of the public who testified early Friday morning in support of this important legislation. [**Click here to view the subcommittee hearing.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg47-EoX9azOuynL3Mnr_6sB4sZ0A9stY4rHW0kF5WgceVigX6Iby9gVY8tRVEiocPVvsQHP3WHOijVINMuRXZF7PnNHCACc-PRQckF1FIfvpDRlPNwd6KUKBMATeW5TyrLc4csLE5JT3MKkDFaonP_aID_Apv2_UjM0XvLjSkWrQsdKeugqKPQxkE7hHgOBOjobaF7r8tcOy1h79_WbcSl_-5NAa4TL3ZEMY2JxQup26Lbz78OJrXjrRTbm28YTL5pbkEpl_BWctpG_KPuq4amKR/4nn/hm-2lL6BQGSCxTUYyKGvtg/h1/h001.VKUSto86vPHeFdnWPcVvfmfReMVscb8mLNMIzXPwiU4) To stay up to date on session business, and to hear what we are discussing in committee, watch livestreams of session and committee meetings using the link below: [**CLICK HERE to watch livestreams of House Floor Session, Committee, and Subcommittee.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxRDqNgIFYI-0uzjPMxc83YIYIcONShShDq3hf99Rp3KxzRIOVq-VSCoXVbtz0hjUJ4XzYRFWCGrBH_fpTuso1j1ewyfaqUZBgxTNnGJGhr923h-3FcmOHRRxVoblOTZXgheKHai63cC5PdlrUNzCSfLP2ZKucDgVksXpGcqeKN-vPX5LG69oiec0IaUkUhiTu1N0_wDAZQH5L8jrlGel-Xc8Qcb165OtTOwkfF0TcXkCDZip8iUVVaR3vgFSoGX3a7PteMIhXv4xz_61IH4tM6EtmpJOjtUz6hmLXCjXGEyKvLHZEC0Nzs6Ppl-uQB1pi_NMHGmQyAQSU3qen0jbIhk7FPrbmDOuuEPp-iE5qniueABKydZDVQtmnS0mO2QDn6cbv-sSosdHiaFLRkhuAkthkTNjf8hOr1Hsk1yNOYC0LxVEeXOPhaeZ9sN1Gp0Yb55uVHiwVjMg49hjSP09IEv6YLd91OnTM6UHxrEbg7ovoDhB4jNIOYRVi1M32V2VKA/4nn/hm-2lL6BQGSCxTUYyKGvtg/h2/h001.HAckLYwwDgaNtTbeGU3tdPJFgxXJemkg0fnwVrMn5IA)
* * *
**I am so excited to share with you some of the great groups I met with this week:** ******I had the pleasure of meeting some of the young upstanding future leaders from the Future Farmers of America chapter from Brentsville High School.** It was a great honor to recognize them and their achievements on the House floor of the General Assembly. Congratulations on the 97th anniversary, and thank you for keeping agriculture alive in Prince William County!! [**Click here to view the House Introduction.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg46dMsVWQxOySt-hk4nW4F6-Mp3sAahwIUleWVprS-Z9ehaeyOu4uypXC6P85_htja_M0s0pnLTCXWDzsC2CNbhWsKfJ005enKIZum0fgmcRQJhhSmHbbPfp0XcGvz57YePbSXIlDcl1TM8Cb9qVsgQc_PTimLKeayb5lwbiV2g8j83PcHg_6-Cy9SHGea7ZJbNzAYeNTL8PP2unoeFrc0M-7R8KLh7mskNO1ibA6n9u87k-YRwmz0TdtLfXmebqmJNxTbC_W998z-Lzc-QFLBgR/4nn/hm-2lL6BQGSCxTUYyKGvtg/h3/h001.7DLaa4I7_Lw7TAUls-WDX89hxvGGutt1lOwftvzcma0) **I was also able to meet with the****[MOVE Chamber](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYmEb1pwpAH5ClaJVoEDAYq4xrANpvYViJMIFPLs_zpUYB8naAQ86PrxyYftA-Aos6KSawLybw1s5F_domAcT_7uXiO8tH2fwBBFJdtCN0XvouQt9iKWwLJAw_48qQhVkjFkBoJKYdLJVtQk82-ySrzuUgPXpAQ-qMhtjtaI-8htNE8D4e8DOvbRLP_9U3TGBH7tH0iCE_M4OEGruhjvycjaMjXgpfSx26LQinMAQg8hACVO88L6vHdYwQa0N2yY3A/4nn/hm-2lL6BQGSCxTUYyKGvtg/h4/h001.f5tAj-50h2LkafGnUY01iQ6EJLy8QHGmy_sZAflb9S0)****.** MOVE connects, informs, promotes, and advocates for American Muslim businesses by providing access to opportunities and removing structural barriers. So glad they stopped by! **As a proud member of the AFSCME, I was proud to support Caucus Chair Kathy Tran (HD 18) and Senate Majority Leader Scott Surrovell (S 34).** This week, they introduced their bill to create more comprehensive guidance for local governments, including state support systems to help reach successful collective bargaining agreements, as well as the creation of the Public Relations Board. This bill builds on legislation I sponsored on collective bargaining rights, and expands a 2020 bill I championed that allowed home health workers to enter into collective bargaining. I am proud to support this legislation. I also had the chance to sit down with Care in Action, a nonprofit group focused on fighting for dignity and fairness for the millions of domestic workers in the United States, most of whom are women of color and immigrant women. ******Thank you so much for your hard work! Go Care in Action!**
* * *
**We also filed three additional bills during this session:** **HB 1404:** Appointment of youth representative to local governing body. This bill creates avenues for youth representatives aged 15-17 to serve as non-voting representatives in their localities, boosting civic engagement. **HB 1438:** Prohibits a state agency or a law-enforcement agency, defined in the bill, from entering into a written agreement authorizing any employee or law-enforcement officer to perform a function of a federal immigration officer. **HB 1502:** Requires the State Air Pollution Control Board to adopt regulations establishing emissions standards for standby generators used at a data center.
* * *
**Local Highlight** We’re featuring excellent individuals and small businesses in the 22nd District in our newsletters! If you’d like to nominate someone or have your business be considered, please email: [deleguzman@house.virginia.gov](mailto:deleguzman@virginia.house.gov). **Today, we’re giving a shout-out to the Brentsville Girls' Flag Football team!!** ************Earlier this year, the Brentsville girls won the inaugural season, beating out the other 11 county teams! The Prince William School Board unanimously approved a resolution making girls' flag football a permanent fall sport, following a successful inaugural season. We are looking forward to their upcoming season. ******Go Tigers!!**

clean_body: | | | I hope everyone is staying inside and warm during this winter weather storm. The Virginia Department of Transportation continues to do a great job clearing roads and ensuring Virginians can go about their daily routines as soon as possible. Stay tuned for more updates. I drove to Richmond (1/26) yesterday and I am happy to report that I-95 southbound is clear and safe to drive. ****Please continue to stay home if you don’t need to drive! We had a very busy second week of the legislative session, and I am excited to share with you what was accomplished. This week started with the new Governor, Abigail Spanberger addressing a joint session of the General Assembly, outlining her vision to create a safer, stronger, and more affordable Commonwealth. We had two bills pass out of subcommittees this week, HB 414 and HB 496. **HB 414 is a bill to remove the Selective Service question from state financial aid. This bipartisan bill cleans up the state code to align with federal law and can save Virginia students up to $5,250 a year. This bill passed unanimously out of both the subcommittee (6-0) and the Appropriations Committee (22-0). It is currently on its Third Reading. This is a huge step toward making sure Virginia stays academically competitive and making state financial aid more accessible. . HB 496 requires data centers to disclose their expected water use for operations. This bill is a win for government transparency and allows localities to plan ahead for water resource allocation and conservation. It passed out of Subcommittee #3 on Friday on a vote of 6-1. Thank you to Friends of Rappahannock, National Parks Conservation Association, Virginia Farm Bureau, League of Conservation, James River Association, Virginia Conservation Network, Virginia Interfaith Power and Light, Virginia Coalition for Open Government, Southern Environmental Law Center, Potomac Rivers Network, Coalition for Smarter Growth, Piedmont Environmental Council, and the members of the public who testified early Friday morning in support of this important legislation. To stay up to date on session business, and to hear what we are discussing in committee, watch livestreams of session and committee meetings using the link below: I am so excited to share with you some of the great groups I met with this week: **I had the pleasure of meeting some of the young upstanding future leaders from the Future Farmers of America chapter from Brentsville High School. It was a great honor to recognize them and their achievements on the House floor of the General Assembly. Congratulations on the 97th anniversary, and thank you for keeping agriculture alive in Prince William County!! I was also able to meet with the. MOVE connects, informs, promotes, and advocates for American Muslim businesses by providing access to opportunities and removing structural barriers. So glad they stopped by! As a proud member of the AFSCME, I was proud to support Caucus Chair Kathy Tran (HD 18) and Senate Majority Leader Scott Surrovell (S 34). This week, they introduced their bill to create more comprehensive guidance for local governments, including state support systems to help reach successful collective bargaining agreements, as well as the creation of the Public Relations Board. This bill builds on legislation I sponsored on collective bargaining rights, and expands a 2020 bill I championed that allowed home health workers to enter into collective bargaining. I am proud to support this legislation. I also had the chance to sit down with Care in Action, a nonprofit group focused on fighting for dignity and fairness for the millions of domestic workers in the United States, most of whom are women of color and immigrant women. ****Thank you so much for your hard work! Go Care in Action! We also filed three additional bills during this session: HB 1404: Appointment of youth representative to local governing body. This bill creates avenues for youth representatives aged 15-17 to serve as non-voting representatives in their localities, boosting civic engagement. HB 1438: Prohibits a state agency or a law-enforcement agency, defined in the bill, from entering into a written agreement authorizing any employee or law-enforcement officer to perform a function of a federal immigration officer. My grandfather became a pediatrician against his family’s wishes in the 1920s. Back then, practicing medicine wasn’t necessarily the well-respected career it is now.

I grew up hearing stories about how basic access to vaccines and clean water saved his patients’ lives. I was so inspired that I wanted to become a doctor, too (you can tell how that worked out).

As a high school student, I traveled to Guatemala to give people there vaccines. I witnessed firsthand the benefits of high vaccination rates — and what happens when folks are forced to go without.

Then, I had my son, Ben, who was born with cerebral palsy. People with disabilities like Ben are more susceptible to illness if vaccines aren’t widely utilized.

Now, with RFK Jr. serving as the Secretary of Health and Human Services under Donald Trump, our nation’s public health couldn’t be more at risk. He spreads dangerous disinformation about vaccines — and most recently, he overhauled the child vaccine schedule to recommend only 11 vaccines rather than the 18 that have been the CDC recommendation for years.

**The bottom line is this: vaccines save lives. They help protect against the preventable spread of contagious diseases, but RFK Jr. is laser-focused on undoing decades of medical advancements._He’s the absolute antithesis of my grandfather._**

RFK Jr. isn't just a jerk — he's a cynical charlatan who's jeopardizing the safety of our entire country. It’s critical that he does not succeed. I will continue calling out his dangerous agenda at every turn, but could really use your support.

clean_body: My grandfather became a pediatrician against his family’s wishes in the 1920s. Back then, practicing medicine wasn’t necessarily the well-respected career it is now. I grew up hearing stories about how basic access to vaccines and clean water saved his patients’ lives. I was so inspired that I wanted to become a doctor, too (you can tell how that worked out). As a high school student, I traveled to Guatemala to give people there vaccines. I witnessed firsthand the benefits of high vaccination rates — and what happens when folks are forced to go without. Then, I had my son, Ben, who was born with cerebral palsy. People with disabilities like Ben are more susceptible to illness if vaccines aren’t widely utilized. Now, with RFK Jr. serving as the Secretary of Health and Human Services under Donald Trump, our nation’s public health couldn’t be more at risk. He spreads dangerous disinformation about vaccines — and most recently, he overhauled the child vaccine schedule to recommend only 11 vaccines rather than the 18 that have been the CDC recommendation for years. The bottom line is this: vaccines save lives. They help protect against the preventable spread of contagious diseases, but RFK Jr. is laser-focused on undoing decades of medical advancements.He’s the absolute antithesis of my grandfather. RFK Jr. isn't just a jerk — he's a cynical charlatan who's jeopardizing the safety of our entire country. It’s critical that he does not succeed. [ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Hours after Alex Pretti was murdered by ICE in broad daylight, the Trump
administration rushed to pin the blame on Alex himself, labeling him a
"domestic terrorist" – ignoring the truth that was captured by multiple
bystanders’ phones. Then, federal agents barred state investigators from
the crime scene and kept facts as basic as the identity of the shooters a
secret.

We saw this same playbook after Renee Good’s murder. First, they launch an
attack. Next, they block the truth from coming out. Now it’s happening

Dear friends, What happened to Alex Pretti in Minneapolis should alarm every American.

Alex was a 37-year-old ICU nurse and U.S. citizen who stepped in during a protest to try to de-escalate a tense situation. Video and eyewitness accounts make clear that while he was lawfully carrying a firearm, he never drew it, never threatened anyone, and was holding only his phone when federal immigration agents pepper-sprayed him, forced him to the ground, and shot him.

**This was not law enforcement. It was the needless destruction of a human life. A man who spent his career saving others was killed while posing no threat.

That reality should stop us cold. It should shake us to our core and crystallize, for every American, how dangerous unchecked power has become.**

Alex was exercising his constitutional rights, and neither his presence nor his peaceful actions justified lethal force. When federal agents kill an innocent person — a neighbor, a colleague, a caregiver — it is a moral failure of our nation’s promise to protect its people.

ICE cannot be allowed to operate without restraint or accountability. Alex’s life mattered. His family deserves answers. And the American people deserve the truth.

I am calling for a full, independent investigation and real accountability for those responsible. Justice demands nothing less.

Sincerely,
Sharif Street

a small burger stand in California in 1948 has grown into much more than a fast-food restaurant.

share the personal story behind this multi-generation family business. An outspoken Christian and mother of four, Lynsi speaks

[] [] [] January 27, 2026 • Newsletter Beyond the Burger: Lynsi Snyder-Ellingson on Faith, Family, and Leadership Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] In-N-Out Burger has become a beloved community staple and an iconic destination for visitors from around the world. What began as a small burger stand in California in 1948 has grown into much more than a fast-food restaurant. In this special conversation, Lynsi Snyder-Ellingson, President and Owner of In-N-Out Burger, sits down with Moms for America to share the personal story behind this multi-generation family business. An outspoken Christian and mother of four, Lynsi speaks candidly about faith, leadership, and the importance of integrity in business today. Like, subscribe and share. Peter, Over the past few days and weeks, every American has witnessed Trump and his enablers deploying ICE as a weapon of terror against immigrant communities and the citizens who bravely defend them. Here in the Central Valley, the impact of ICE roaming through our streets isn’t abstract or political -- _it’s deeply personal._ Many of our communities live in constant fear because they know that the color of their skin makes it dangerous just to leave their home. And right when we need our leaders to stand up for us the most, many of them are choosing silence or soaring speeches instead of using their power to protect our neighbors. We deserve leaders who will fight for us like our lives depend on it. Because whether it’s in the Central Valley or Minnesota, they do. My heart is with the family and friends of the two courageous Americans killed by ICE - Alex Pretti and Renee Good, and with every one of you who is in this fight with me, especially when it’s not easy. In solidarity,

* * *
Trump's White House is in full-blown panic mode, flailing left and right with PR plays to ease the political and legal shitstorm they've walked themselves into after the chaos, the violence, and the death in Minneapolis these last few weeks.
To the average bystander--or to the media types who treat politics like sports, calling balls and strikes--it might _look_ like Trump and his advisors are _finally_ taking the death of Alex Pretti seriously. But we know better. This is just PR. Rearranging deck chairs on the goddamn Titanic.
They're leaking against Kristi Noem, setting her up as the scapegoat. They've shoved Greg Bovino into early retirement. They're whispering that Stephen Miller--Trump's golden boy--is "losing influence" and "increasingly isolated" in the West Wing.
I don't buy a single bit of it.
At best, we'll get a temporary pause. A little strategic restraint to keep Republicans in Congress from jumping ship. But there won't be real reform. No accountability for Alex Pretti's death. None for Renee Good's. None for the ICE agents who choked a man to death in Texas.
And Stephen Miller? Please. That little weasel is still at the center of it all. Vance, Trump, Fox News, the whole damn lot of them idolize him. Tom Homan, the man running ICE operations in Minnesota now, thinks the guy is a genius.
* * *

Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/ff95cd1c-1d8d-42be-b391-056fb939b8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/ff95cd1c-1d8d-42be-b391-056fb939b8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Speaking of Homan--he's no better than Bovino, now that he's been handed the reins in Minneapolis and likely more authority as part of Trump's broader, brutal agenda: sending out unqualified ICE and CBP agents to kidnap people and terrorize immigrant communities.
This administration is desperate. They're seeing the same poll numbers we are. Back in 2018, Americans barely had an opinion on ICE. Earlier this year, disapproval crept into the low single digits. Now? It's nearly 30% negative--and that was _before_ the public had fully processed the execution of Alex Pretti, broad daylight and all.
We can't let this end with a few bullshit PR stunts meant to tamp down the flames and buy time until the next crisis. We can't get distracted by whatever nonsense Trump throws out next--be it Greenland, Epstein, or the next sideshow.
Democrats need to step the hell up. Use every ounce of power they have, even in the minority, to stop this from getting worse. That means blocking the appropriations bill in the Senate. It means unified "no" votes in the House. It means leaning hard into oversight. And if there's a confirmation hearing to replace Noem, Democrats need to throw sand in the gears and force Republicans to ram it through--just like they did with Pete Hegseth, a move that burned them politically.
Ask Thom Tillis why he's retiring. He'll point right to that.
We have to keep demanding accountability.
What keeps me up at night--even more than the awful, graphic footage of Alex Pretti's murder--is the next one. Because this thing is snowballing. Fast.
Trump pardoned the January 6th insurrectionists to send a message: "If you're on my team, I've got your back." So when the ICE agent who murdered Renee Good sees JD Vance saying agents have _total immunity_ , that's what leads us to what happened on Saturday.
A gang of untrained, unqualified, masked men--many of whom couldn't pass a background check or a drug test--pretending to be law enforcement, doing whatever the hell they want. And they believe, with good reason, that Trump will pardon them. That Vance will shield them. That Pam Bondi's DOJ won't even investigate, let alone prosecute.
They'll do what they did after Alex Pretti's murder--pluck the agent out of state, move him somewhere else, bury his name, stonewall local investigators. Have his back.
And that tells every one of these guys: Next time, go even further.
They managed to spin their way out of Renee Good's murder for some Americans. "She was impeding an investigation." "She might've hit him with her car." Total horseshit. You and I know that.
But Alex Pretti? That was a straight-up execution. Caught on tape. He did nothing wrong. He was filming. He was helping a woman shoved to the ground by an ICE agent--for doing nothing.
And for that, they pepper-sprayed him. Beat him. Shot him in the back. He's gone.
His friends, his family, his community--wrecked. A wound that won't heal.
And still, no signs of real accountability. Just political theater, with Trump playing checkers while the media nods along. But I'm not playing along. I won't.
Yeah, Greg Bovino is gone. I hope he enjoys his fruity drinks in retirement, probably already working on his MAGA podcast debut by the end of February.
But nothing's changed on the ground. People are still being kidnapped, assaulted, harassed for the color of their skin.
The fight goes on. The cause endures.
We can acknowledge the minor movement--but don't mistake it for progress. I don't believe it's real.
We have to keep speaking up. Showing up. Defending our neighbors. Making calls. Dropping off meals. Coordinating school pickup. Doing the work. Finding your lane.
Like I said yesterday: stay in the fight. And please--take care of yourself. It's been a brutal few days. Log off. Drink some water. Take a nap. Hug your kids. Whatever you need--just take care.
We need you here.

**Team, we are heartbroken and outraged.** We mourn this needless death alongside the victim’s family, the Minneapolis community, and every American who is rightly horrified by the Administration's indefensible actions.

Secretary Kristi Noem is ultimately responsible and should be fired immediately or resign in disgrace.

subject: MAGA states left a nonprofit, independent voter data verification system
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
CNN: Florida, West Virginia and Missouri withdraw from bipartisan effort aimed at maintaining accurate voter rolls [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/CNN_ERIC_Withdrawl.png]
The Electronic Registration Information Center, also known as ERIC, is a nonprofit system that helps participating states keep their registration rolls accurate and up to date by analyzing voter data and sharing reports with members , in order for them to update their voter rolls, remove ineligible voters and investigate potential voter fraud.
States from Florida, West Virginia and Missouri to Alabama, Louisiana and Texas withdrew in the last few years. Critics of the withdrawals have argued that leaving ERIC will make it harder to verify that voter rolls are up to date in each state .
We want to hear from voters in your area about this tactic. Will you take our one-click poll right away?

Peter, Our nation is at a critical inflection point, and Minnesota has become the test case for the future of our local democracies and our republic. Right now, our neighbors in the Twin Cities are facing what can only be described as a lawless, violent assault. Under "Operation Metro Surge," thousands of masked federal agents have descended upon Minnesota - not to ensure public safety, but to bypass local authority and terrorize communities. From the tragic killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti to the racial profiling of U.S. citizens, this invasion is a direct violation of our fundamental rights. When schools are forced into lockdown and local law enforcement is sidelined by federal overreach, our very democracy is under siege. _We cannot stay silent. We must harness the power of our local institutions to STOP this unconstitutional occupation. Minnesota is standing defiant, and they need the rest of the country to stand with them._ __**Take action now. **I 'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... **
**- STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms**

name: The Democrats
subject: Not normal.
body:
---
Derek, What’s happening right now is not normal. But, as we’re sure you’re aware, things haven’t been normal since the beginning of the Trump administration. It’s not normal to be governed by someone who has been convicted of 34 felonies and who demonstrates again and again how little he respects the rule of law. It’s not normal for our fellow Americans to be under occupation in their neighborhood streets, threatened by federal agents with masks and guns. It’s not normal for the federal government to be detaining, brutalizing, and murdering Americans in the streets for exercising their First Amendment rights — and then lying about it. **None of this is normal.** Trump’s goal is to destroy faith in American institutions and the rule of law and plunge us into an authoritarian society. **But we’re not powerless, as long as we stand together.** We saw a spark of hope amid the chaos in the protests in Minnesota on Friday, when tens of thousands of people braved temperatures as low as -20° Fahrenheit and took to the streets to demand an end to Donald Trump's crackdown in their city. _That_ is the power of the people on full display. We are living in a pivotal moment in American history. And until Democrats win back Congress, its Republican leaders will continue to fecklessly allow Donald Trump’s chaos. There will be no progress made on any of the issues affecting the American people. It’s critical that we win races up and down the ballot this midterm, and to do that, we need to continue to show up for one another and organize our neighbors, our communities, and our cities. **Because when we stand together united, we can never be defeated.** Keep showing up. Keep caring. Keep standing up for one another. That’s how we honor the memories of Alex Pretti and Renee Good, and how we keep fighting for those who are being targeted by the ruthless cruelty of this administration. Thank you for standing up for your community, The Democrats

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

body:

Derek,

Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Vindman just announced his candidacy
for U.S. Senate, and I’m proud to give him my endorsement.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-alexvindman26.LuyiPk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260127_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=9455%2E5257348%2E66q2sr ]Will you make a split donation between me and Alexander to become a
Founding Donor of his campaign?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-alexvindman26.LuyiPk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260127_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=9455%2E5257348%2E66q2sr ]SPLIT A DONATION

Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman exemplifies courage and leadership. He defended
our nation in the U.S. Army, and he stood up for our democracy when he
testified before Congress during the first impeachment of Donald Trump.

On July 25, 2019, Alex witnessed a telephone call between President Donald
Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, during which Trump
pressured President Zelensky to announce an investigation into then-former
Vice President Joe Biden in order to continue receiving United States
military aid.

You might remember when Alex bravely testified before Congress that he
could speak out against the most powerful man in the world because “here
right matters.” I still believe that, and Alex and I worked together to
shed light on a blatant abuse of power by the president of the United
States — and we will do so again.

Now, Alex is running for U.S. Senate in Florida to continue the fight for

| Good morning Friend,
Education freedom is no longer a future debate — it’s unfolding right now in Mississippi. With **HB2 having passed the Mississippi House and now moving to the Senate** , school choice has moved from theory to action. That’s why we’re bringing **Corey DeAngelis** to Jackson on **Tuesday, February 10** , for a timely, high-impact discussion on what education freedom means for Mississippi families. Corey DeAngelis is one of the most influential voices in the national school choice movement. His research and advocacy have helped shape education reforms across the country at a moment when education freedom is gaining unprecedented momentum — including support from the Trump administration and the U.S. Department of Education, which has publicly highlighted Mississippi’s progress. Hearing directly from a national leader while Mississippi legislation is actively moving is a rare opportunity. This event also brings together a strong lineup of Mississippi leaders who are advancing education freedom on the ground:
* **Starla Brown** ,**State Director of Americans for Prosperity Mississippi** , leading grassroots efforts to turn policy into action
* **Lindsey Beckham** , **State Chair, Mississippi Legislative Chair, and Madison County Chapter Chair for Moms for Liberty** , elevating parent voices in education policy
* **Leah Ferretti** , **Director of Mississippi Ready** , focused on expanding education options for Mississippi families

---
