| | My job is to listen to your perspectives and improve life here in Northwest Washington through legislation and advocacy in Congress. **It is an honor to represent Northwest Washington, one I do not take for granted.** Last year, we faced many uncertainties. My office received over twice as many constituent messages as the year prior. People are concerned about the actions of this administration, the Republican Rip-Off, and what it all means for Northwest Washington. Despite President Trump and the Republican Rip-Off's attacks on our values, I spent last year addressing affordability, standing up for health care, fighting for veterans, improving transportation and infrastructure, and protecting immigrants in our communities. Here are just some of the actions I took last year:
* I supported legislation to extend the Affordable Care Act tax subsidies and keep insurance premiums affordable for working families
* I am co-leading legislation to protect seniors from the new red tape the Trump administration is implementing in traditional Medicare by repealing the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services' Wasteful and Inappropriate Service Reduction (WISeR) model
* I voted against the "Big Ugly Law," which drives up health care costs by cutting Medicaid and takes away health care from 22,000 people in Northwest Washington
* I hosted local roundtables with veterans in Everett, Bellingham, Burlington, Oak Harbor, and Lummi Nation, and published a report detailing veterans' most pressing challenges and policies to address them
* I secured the release of millions of dollars in federal funding for local transportation and infrastructure projects in Northwest Washington

I will continue to stand up to this administration and the Republican Rip-Off, and I am proud to be in this fight with you. Friend,

Like millions across the country, I am disgusted by another state-sanctioned murder in Minnesota. These last few weeks of ICE activity have been a failure of justice, and I’m demanding accountability in Congress.

**These are not the actions of the country I swore to defend when I enlisted in the Army, nor was it of the country that my parents fled Vietnam and risked everything for.**

These are difficult times, but we cannot afford to look away. This is a uniquely critical moment for our democracy, and I’m doing everything in my power to get oversight and protect our communities.

The hard truth is that without Democratic control of the House, my GOP colleagues across the aisle are using their cowardice to do nothing -- just a few days ago, they voted to give over $10 billion to ICE.

Whether we like it or not, what happens in November’s midterm elections will shape the next few years. We need to win the majority and fight back against the unchecked MAGA agenda.

**[If you’re able, $3 or any amount would immediately make an impact in my hyper-competitive race. Mother Jones: DOJ’s “Ransom” Letter to Minnesota Reveals How Trump Plans to Rig the Midterms [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012726_2&amount=25]
This is sickening, Team.
On the same day a masked ICE agent executed Alex Pretti on the street in Minneapolis, Attorney General Pam Bondi sent a letter to Minnesota Governor Tim Walz stating that if he wanted to “ bring an end to the chaos in Minnesota ,” he should comply with some “ common sense solutions .”
What did MAGA Pam Bondi have in mind? For Minnesota to provide the Department of Justice with full, unredacted access to the state’s complete voter roll. "Unredacted" means including sensitive personal information like voters’ Social Security numbers, drivers license data, and party affiliations.
That's right -- the ICE occupation of Minneapolis isn't about immigration at all , but Trump using his personal attack force like a mafia threat to break kneecaps from a bad movie. Thankfully, pro-voting rights leaders in Minnesota are resisting these autocratic, strongman tactics and standing up for our fundamental rights.
We have to stand with Minnesotans and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. States run our elections, not the federal government, even if our Attorney General ( the theoretical top law enforcement officer in the country ) doesn't understand that basic law.
Bondi claimed that the DOJ needed the state’s full voter roll in order to “ confirm Minnesota’s voter registration practices comply with federal law .”
It's all just cover for an outrageous attempt by the Trump administration to coerce Minnesota into providing confidential voter data that would be weaponized by the president and his allies to amplify false claims of voter fraud, wrongly remove eligible voters from the rolls, and challenge election results.
Just last week the MAGA DOJ was forced to admit that DOGE employees entered an illegal agreement to give confidential information from the Social Security Administration to a voter suppression group . Do we really think that the opponents of voting rights who run the Trump administration would do any different with state data?
Every step of the Trump and MAGA plan to suppress the vote is about protecting the power they have and rigging election results in advance by choosing who is worthy of voting. subject: Democrats must unite to defend the rule of law against ICE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
I'm in Minneapolis to thank protestors for standing up for our freedoms and to learn more about what’s happening firsthand.
ICE has become a rogue, militarized police force on behalf of the Trump administration. They are coming after all of us—immigrants and American citizens alike—terrorizing our communities through physical assault, kidnapping, and even murder.
Congress has the power to stop this. Democrats must do everything they can to restore and defend the rule of law. That’s why Carlos Eduardo Espina and I are rolling out a 10-point plan to hold ICE accountable and reform immigration enforcement:
✅ Vote no on the DHS funding bill.
✅ Repeal the multi-year $75 billion funding for ICE.
✅ Impeach Noem and Bondi.
✅ End qualified immunity for ICE agents.
✅ Investigate and prosecute every single ICE agent who broke the law.
✅ End the Kavanaugh stops with racial profiling and the militarization of ICE.
✅ Codify a use-of-force standard so courts can enforce the law against rogue ICE agents.
✅ Tear down and replace ICE with an agency that has oversight.
✅ Prohibit masks and mandate body cameras and visible identification for immigration officers.
✅ Establish human rights standards at immigration detention facilities.

name: Christina Hines
subject: Another ICE shooting
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Christina for Congress
body:
https://www.christinahinesforcongress.com/ [https://www.christinahinesforcongress.com/]
Dear friend, it’s Christina Hines.
I am horrified by the news that another American citizen was tragically shot and killed by federal law enforcement. Americans can see what happened with their own eyes and know this is not okay.
As a prosecutor, I worked closely with law enforcement to keep our communities safe. I know what professional law enforcement looks like.
What we’ve seen from DHS and all over the country isn’t that. Our local police departments are held to high standards, and they are trained to de-escalate conflict to save lives. That is not what we are seeing in Minneapolis. This administration is creating chaos, hurting our communities, and undermining local law enforcement’s efforts to keep us safe.
This shooting requires a full investigation by state and local authorities, and it needs to happen immediately .
This is not what America looks like and it is up to all of us to fight for the change we want to see. Together, we can carry this pain, honor Alex and Renee’s memory, and work towards a better tomorrow.
— Christina
https://www.christinahinesforcongress.com/ [https://www.christinahinesforcongress.com/] Christina is a lifelong advocate for justice and a former prosecutor for survivors of sexual assault, child abuse, and human trafficking.
Now she’s running to bring that same dedication to Congress, working to put the middle class first, protect the American Dream, and ensure every community can thrive. She fights for safe neighborhoods, fair opportunities, and a future where everyone can succeed.

subject: We can’t let them win
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.
I need your help in this fight. If you’re able, please split a donation between our Legal Defense fund and Real Texas PAC and make sure we can continue to stand up to Donald Trump and his DOJ? Trump's plot for a third term just won't die.
In November, Defend Our Courts helped lead the defense of Pennsylvania's Supreme Court. We stopped MAGA from seizing control of the court that oversees how elections are run in the nation's biggest swing state. It was a blowout victory and a crucial win for democracy.
But what happened at the White House made it clear that the battle against a Trump third term is far from over. Trump has a fallback plan, and it runs straight through the courts in Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, and Wisconsin.
In 2026, the Supreme Courts of these critical states are on the ballot. If MAGA can buy these seats, they won't need to win an election in 2028, they'll just have their hand-picked judges throw out results they don't like.
The threat didn't go away after PA. It just quadrupled.
Defend Our Courts is once again leading the vanguard, rallying our over 100,000 grassroots supporters from every corner of this country to defend these three crucial courts.
But we cannot fight several fires at once without your immediate help. The stakes are higher than they have ever been.

body:
New Hampshire’s Senate race is tied. And I’m rattled.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: **I don’t rattle easily.**
But this race in New Hampshire? **It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country.**
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas pull ahead right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260127_2.7f7R5R&refcode=em20260127-2&t=1&akid=4804%2E582294%2EiqALbi)**

Here’s the deal: Jeanne Shaheen is retiring. That means this seat is wide open. **And now John Sununu — yes, one of those Sununus, the long-time New Hampshire political dynasty — is running to flip it red.**
He’s got the name, he’s got the money, and he’s got the full weight of the Republican donor class behind him — from Wall Street to the far-right Super PACs. They see New Hampshire as their ticket to locking down the Senate for another decade.
And right now? **This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way.**
Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — _CANNOT_ — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare to help Chris take the lead and hold the line in New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260127_2.7f7R5R&refcode=em20260127-2&t=3&akid=4804%2E582294%2EiqALbi)**

The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. And they’re ready to bury us in negative ads and dark money.
We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. **Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch.**

We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch. Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate. — James Carville New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The shootings have to stop. The cover-ups have to stop. The bankrolling of this violence has to stop.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2756%2E4032634%2EyZIqsU)
---
Trump’s federal agents shot and killed another person in Minnesota: Alex Pretti, an ICU nurse who served veterans in his community. When agents pushed a woman to the ground right next to him, he tried to help her up. His last words were “Are you okay?” And he was shot. The shootings have to stop. The cover-ups have to stop. The bankrolling of this violence has to stop. We can all see with our own eyes what ICE is doing to our neighbors. Congress can — and must — step up. There’s a Department of Homeland Security funding bill heading to the Senate this week, and I’m calling on every single Senator — Republicans and Democrats — to oppose it. We are now in a position to slam the brakes and put some serious conditions on any money that ICE gets — including money approved earlier that they are still spending. I want to be clear: If it were up to me, we would completely overhaul ICE, stop shoveling money into their budget, strip the agency down to its studs and end their abuses altogether. Hard stop. And I’m going to keep fighting for that. But in the short-term, this is one of the best options we’ve got to condition any funding with specific demands that would have an immediate impact. [**This is the time to be loud about this. Click here to find out how to call your Senators now and urge them to vote NO on DHS funding this week.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/call/wfs-call-reps-ice/?source=EMZ29K_DHS_E_20260127_V1S1&t=8&akid=2756%2E4032634%2EyZIqsU) Even if you assume your Senators are already voting no, call them to make your expectations clear and thank them. Even if you assume your Senators would never vote no, call them to make sure they hear from you as a constituent and make your demands clear. We have a chance to use the upcoming funding bill to stop ICE from terrorizing our communities and putting lives at risk. It’s time for the Senate to step up, put some basic controls in place, and stop the violence. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

subject: Most People Miss This
body:
With roughly 15% of shares left, this moment isn't about belief--it's about access.

Dear _Flyover_ Reader, **I want to be very honest with you.** At this point in an investment round - the final days - almost everyone is paying attention -- but very few people are still ready to act. We just announced there are just 10 days left to invest in _The Flyover_. Today, that window is even smaller. With only about 15% of the shares remaining, we are now in the final allocation phase of this round. This is the part most people miss. Not because they don't believe in the company.
Not because they don't like the mission.
But because they assume there will be more time. There won't be. Once these remaining shares are allocated, this round is closed -- regardless of the calendar. **And when it closes, that 's it.** No extensions.
No "one more chance."
No reopening this round later. What makes this moment different from everything we've written before is simple: this is no longer about convincing people -- it's about availability. **_The Flyover_ is already what most media startups never become:**
* Profitable
* Growing rapidly
* Trusted by millions of readers
* Built without corporate ownership or political donors

That part is no longer theoretical. It's already true. What is still optional -- for a very short time -- is whether you are an owner while this next phase of growth happens. **As we look ahead, we are expanding:**
* Into more states
* Into deeper audio and video distribution
* Into products like texting and the Flyover app
* Into a larger, more durable media company built for the long term

Those plans are being funded today. They're underway. The only question now is who is still able to participate before this round closes. If you've been waiting for a clearer signal -- this is it. Not because of marketing.
Not because of urgency language.
But because the remaining shares are being actively allocated, and once they're gone, the decision is no longer yours to make. If you want to join _The Flyover_ as an owner, I encourage you to do it now -- while shares are still available. **[Invest in _The Flyover_ here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0b-O2zAMBvCnkbcEMiXb50FDAcObe8sBHQVVomMW-mNYTIK-feH2gi4dO__ID_zAb4tdHEXKt68uoeG12ICBvGMMNuOzRmTGw6ZSeceyR0xUK29ULUjoL7K9wGD9-ncJoAlmRQRUDZp26MdOKw1jsxk9dLi-Ba2khnXUSnrtxzdw4NF1YwgNmTNUtjC0Yyehv3byO3bYh1YP6AEGoSUG4nJcfxTKvOEaf5YHHldfUhPNxrxXob4ImAXMlB9Y-R-TJ6v5zsnWcj88CjVNr_sF9CckDHRPQk3vz4zhsmAg90nepd3RLQs1zX8yX1AyY2ahpoVq_diofgLjcUZ9zO-TbWGAvjlM2J8UI9X-7HRLjuLvDvyfXvAw8CsAAP__kGyg4w)** Thank you for reading -- and for taking this seriously.
We don't take your attention lightly - and as a Flyover reader we want you to join us - especially at this stage. With appreciation,
Guy Short
Founder, _The Flyover_ **P.S. Many of the strongest companies are defined not by who wanted to invest -- but by who was able to invest before the round closed. With roughly 15% of shares remaining, this is the final allocation window. Once it closes, there are no more shares in this offering.**

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2049%2E791427%2ETJKa6t)
See this guy?
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260127-1-180&akid=2049%2E791427%2ETJKa6t)
That’s Greg Bovino. He’s been leading the on-the-ground operations for DHS and ICE here in Minnesota.
He’s a bully, a liar, and an authoritarian. He told the shameless lie that Alex Pretti was trying to “massacre law enforcement” just hours after he was killed. He has overseen ICE agents as they beat and brutalize people, invade people’s homes, and trample on basic civil rights.
**Yesterday, he got taken off the job. Demoted.**
Why? Because his reign over ICE’s crackdown has been chaotic, violent, and deadly, the White House is finally feeling the heat.
That’s right: the administration is finally seeing the writing on the wall. Their violent immigration agenda is political poison, and Americans simply won’t stand for it. It’s unpopular, unconstitutional, and un-American.
**This is the first major victory in our fight to get ICE out of Minnesota.**
Make no mistake, our protests, organizing, and community action have made this possible. Our resistance to ICE’s outright fascism has made it harder for them to continue this reign of terror. _But the fight is not over yet._
Greg Bovino may be the first to take the heat for Trump’s failed administration, but the problem goes all the way to the top.
DHS Secretary Kristi Noem is responsible for everything that has happened in Minnesota, including the deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.
She slandered these two innocent souls as “domestic terrorists” and is actively shielding her agents from facing accountability for cold-blooded murder. She’s incompetent, and her leadership is a danger to our communities. **Kristi Noem needs to go.**
[**If you agree, sign onto my petition calling for Congress to begin impeachment proceedings against Kristi Noem. Momentum is on our side. The American people are on our side, Democrats, independents, and Republicans alike. Pressure is mounting against this administration, which means now is the time to keep pushing until we get real justice.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260127-1-180&akid=2049%2E791427%2ETJKa6t)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260127-1-180&akid=2049%2E791427%2ETJKa6t)**
As I said, this is our first victory in this fight, but it’s far from over. ICE is still in the streets, tearing families apart. We must keep going.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Fellow Conservative, I'll keep this note brief and to the point because we don't have much time left. **_With the end-of-month deadline rapidly approaching, we 're in grave danger of _MISSING_ our January fundraising goal! _** I wish I could say I was surprised... | | Dear Peter,
---
Ready for some big news? We’re thrilled to announce a rare chance to acquire 200 acres of stunning redwood forest in a strategic Sonoma County location—directly adjacent to Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve. In 2018, Save the Redwoods League acquired the 730-acre Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve, home to hundreds of old-growth coast redwoods more than 300 feet tall. Together with supporters like you, we made conservation history and protected this spectacular forest for generations to come. Now we have the opportunity to **[expand the reserve](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124153424/597720764/-479769549?utm_source=ea-mar&utm_campaign=hrrre&utm_medium=email&sourceid=1168358&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA3OThiZGI4LWJkZmItZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N1_75WZktve9abQxp_UbXDSdnkXon7Z27Hv7Bb6D8TE=&emci=2afcb386-2cf7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=0798bdb8-bdfb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=1504551) **by over 25%, creating a 930-acre redwood sanctuary that will benefit local communities and future visitors alike.
---
---
**[This is a rare chance to preserve and expand an irreplaceable forest. Join us as we raise $4 million to secure this vital addition to the reserve.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124153425/597720765/1661527318?utm_source=ea-mar&utm_campaign=hrrre&utm_medium=email&sourceid=1168358&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA3OThiZGI4LWJkZmItZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N1_75WZktve9abQxp_UbXDSdnkXon7Z27Hv7Bb6D8TE=&emci=2afcb386-2cf7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=0798bdb8-bdfb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=1504551)** Every acquisition we make is guided by clear conservation priorities, and this property meets each one beautifully.**• It** **protects old growth.** This expansion includes 35 acres of awe-inspiring old-growth groves, as well as thriving young trees that will become tomorrow’s giants. Safeguarding these redwoods means they can continue to draw down carbon for crucial climate resilience. **• It safeguards wildlife.** The expansion protects habitat for the diverse wildlife that call the redwood ecosystem home, including northern spotted owls, the elusive Sonoma tree vole, and imperiled coho salmon. **• It builds wildfire resilience.** The expansion lets us remove fire fuels from the forests surrounding the old-growth heart of the reserve. These efforts will buffer these irreplaceable trees and help lower wildfire risk in Sonoma County. **• It secures the path to public access.** Since 2023, we’ve offered limited guided hikes and activities at the reserve. With input from the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians and the local community, this expansion will usher in a new phase of public access planning. We’ve already laid the groundwork for this exciting expansion. Now, with the help of supporters like you, we seek to raise the $4 million needed to make this incredible opportunity a reality.Together, let’s make history again.

clean_body: This is our moment to add 200 acres to Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve| | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, Ready for some big news? We’re thrilled to announce a rare chance to acquire 200 acres of stunning redwood forest in a strategic Sonoma County location—directly adjacent to Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve. In 2018, Save the Redwoods League acquired the 730-acre Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve, home to hundreds of old-growth coast redwoods more than 300 feet tall. Together with supporters like you, we made conservation history and protected this spectacular forest for generations to come. Now we have the opportunity to by over 25%, creating a 930-acre redwood sanctuary that will benefit local communities and future visitors alike. Every acquisition we make is guided by clear conservation priorities, and this property meets each one beautifully.• It protects old growth. This expansion includes 35 acres of awe-inspiring old-growth groves, as well as thriving young trees that will become tomorrow’s giants. Safeguarding these redwoods means they can continue to draw down carbon for crucial climate resilience. • It safeguards wildlife. The expansion protects habitat for the diverse wildlife that call the redwood ecosystem home, including northern spotted owls, the elusive Sonoma tree vole, and imperiled coho salmon. • It builds wildfire resilience. The expansion lets us remove fire fuels from the forests surrounding the old-growth heart of the reserve. These efforts will buffer these irreplaceable trees and help lower wildfire risk in Sonoma County. • It secures the path to public access. Since 2023, we’ve offered limited guided hikes and activities at the reserve. With input from the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians and the local community, this expansion will usher in a new phase of public access planning. We’ve already laid the groundwork for this exciting expansion. Now, with the help of supporters like you, we seek to raise the $4 million needed to make this incredible opportunity a reality.Together, let’s make history again. | | With gratitude, Save the Redwoods League Photos by Justin Lewis/Coldwater Collective | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States CONNECT WITH US | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

body:
ICE was given a mission by Donald Trump, JD Vance, and Kristi Noem

Derek, a fundamental responsibility of government is to keep people safe and build trust in our communities. That's the opposite of what the Trump Administration is doing. ICE was given a mission by Donald Trump, JD Vance, and Kristi Noem — a mission that is violating people’s constitutional rights, wreaking havoc on our communities, and has led to two tragic killings in the streets. **It’s time to terminate the mission.** Take it from a former Attorney General: I've spent my entire career standing with law enforcement, and I've been proud to have their support in every statewide race I've run here in Pennsylvania. **Now, the President needs to listen to actual law enforcement leaders and stop the CBP and ICE operations that are making us all less safe.** This mission in Minnesota is compromised, Derek. And it’s time for it to end. – Josh Shapiro

I swore an oath to protect this country when I joined the U.S. Army more than two decades ago.
In 2019, I honored that oath by blowing the whistle on Donald Trump's corrupt phone call with Ukraine, an act that led to Trump's first impeachment and ultimately cost me my military career.
People told me to keep my head down. But my family came here as refugees to escape tyranny. I sure as hell wasn't going to bow down to a wannabe tyrant.
This president unleashed a reign of terror and retribution, not just against me and my family, but against all of us.
Today, our country is in chaos. We are entering a dark chapter of American history, one that echoes early stages of authoritarian power consolidation seen elsewhere.
Thug militias attacking citizens. Tariffs pushing prices sky-high. Healthcare premiums through the roof. While all of this is happening, my opponent refuses to put the interests of the American people before her own self-interest.
Ashley Moody screwed Florida homeowners by caving to the big insurance companies, supported this administration that gutted disaster help for communities trying to rebuild, and had over a million dollars in her corporate stock traded last year while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
They put Ashley Moody in the Senate to be a 'yes' vote for Trump and the billionaires. She's not Florida's senator. She's theirs.
We need someone who isn't afraid to put a check on an outlaw president, to defend our democracy, and to make sure that every American has a fair chance at prosperity.
That is why I am running for Senate, and why I am humbly asking you:

$1.00. You read that right, Peter. We're humbly asking for **just $1** ahead of our first major deadline of 2026 this Saturday. If you’re ready to chip in and send a proven leader like Roy Cooper to the U.S. Senate, **[click here now and chip in $1>>>](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5174?t=7&akid=428%2E124072%2EhPyGof)** You already know Roy Cooper is running to deliver for working families. To fight for affordable health care. To stand up for our rights. To create good-paying jobs. To bring real, results-driven leadership back to Washington. What you might not know is _just how much_ we rely on people like you opening these emails and chipping in here and there, when you can. **That’s why we’re seriously asking you for just $1 today.** We know you’re wondering how the heck $1 will fund a winning Senate campaign. But it’s not about the dollar — it’s about every person reading this email who steps through the door and says, _“I’m with Roy.”_ With that attitude, we'd close the gap to our January goal in no time. Maybe even BEFORE Saturday’s fundraising deadline. **But the bottom line is this:** Roy’s counting on us to help flip this Senate seat. The _nation_ is counting on us to help Roy flip this Senate seat. We can’t do that without folks like you stepping up when you can. Period. **[So we’ll ask again: Whether this is your first donation or whether you’ve been a longtime Team Cooper supporter — can Roy count on you to chip in $1 (or more if you can) before the campaign’s first big fundraising deadline this Saturday?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5174?t=8&akid=428%2E124072%2EhPyGof)** | [DONATE $1](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5174?t=9&akid=428%2E124072%2EhPyGof)

Team Cooper for NC
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

What we raise before this deadline will determine how effectively we counter these attacks and finish strong. Please consider contributing again before the January deadline.

| | Patriot,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn't a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal -- the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God's grace. **

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." **_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.

When you read it, you will hear Charlie's voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie's hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

In the months since Charlie's assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA's message among young Americans...

...and it's not just the conservative message as a whole -- _**it 's the message of FAITH! **_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie's call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it 's happening. _

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we're witnessing is not just growth --**it 's revival. **

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America 's faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. **

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _" We're not backing down." _

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie's most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie 's faith. _**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

body:
Eric Coomer’s court admissions reignite unresolved questions in Colorado’s Mesa County election case
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Immigration and political tensions are sharpening as voters prepare to weigh a constitutional amendment requiring greater [cooperation between local law enforcement and federal immigration authorities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in cases involving violent crime or prior felonies—a direct challenge to the state’s sanctuary-style policies. That debate unfolds as ICE investigates reports of [“death symbol” cards left in vehicles](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after Eagle County detentions, incidents the agency says may constitute intimidation. Meanwhile, Colorado Republicans are reassessing how to break a [two-decade losing streak in gubernatorial races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), debating strategy, electability, and how to win back unaffiliated voters.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Commentators warned that [parents are steadily losing authority to schools and bureaucracies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), urging Washington to reassert family primacy. At the same time, the Trump administration began reviewing roughly [$88 million in pandemic loans to Planned Parenthood](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Democrats also advanced legislation that would [bar ICE officers from future government jobs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a move critics argue punishes law enforcement for enforcing federal law.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** One piece argues the modern [income tax departed from the Founders’ intent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), enabling unchecked federal growth. Another revisits unresolved election integrity questions following court [admissions by a Dominion executive](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado’s Mesa County case. A third contends that [protest is not a license for disorder](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), warning that excusing intimidation and obstruction undermines the rule of law and public trust. A fourth shows how [so-called affordable housing projects in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are heavily financed by taxpayer dollars through state grants, federal COVID relief funds, tax credits, and Prop 123 money redirected from TABOR refunds, rather than private-market solutions.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, January 27, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Eric Coomer’s court admissions reignite unresolved questions in Colorado’s Mesa County election case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY A.L. GOODWIN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Recent court filings in Coomer v. Byrne et al., Case No. 8:24-cv-00008-TPB-SPF (M.D. Fla.), contain sworn admissions by Dr. Eric Coomer, the former Director of Product Strategy and Security for Dominion Voting Systems, that materially alter the public understanding of foreign interaction with U.S. election system technology.
Filed on January 23, 2026, Coomer’s responses acknowledge that he worked directly with foreign individuals and foreign-based employees on Dominion voting equipment, adjudication software, election system code, and programming.
_The sworn responses themselves are contained in the court filing embedded in the article [click below]._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[How the Income Tax Betrayed the Founding and Broke the Constitution’s Promise of Liberty](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **A permanent claim on personal labor:** The commentary argues the modern income tax violates the Founders’ vision of limited government by giving Washington an ongoing claim on citizens’ work, severing the link between consent, taxation, and self-determination.

* **Unlimited government growth and coercion:** By providing elastic, automatic revenue, the income tax enables unchecked federal expansion, fuels bureaucratic overreach, and turns the tax code into a tool for social engineering and political favoritism.

* **Erosion of accountability and liberty:** Withholding and complexity hide the true cost of government, dulling voter scrutiny while forcing citizens into constant disclosure and dependence—conditions the author says are incompatible with a free republic.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[There Is No Constitutional Right to “Protest”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MICHAEL J BADAGLIACCO "MJB", [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* ******The Constitution protects peaceable assembly—not disruption:** The commentary explains that the First Amendment guarantees the right to peaceably assemble and petition government, not an unlimited right to “protest,” a term that does not appear anywhere in the Constitution and has been widely misused to excuse disorder.

* **Supreme Court precedent draws a clear line:** Citing cases like De Jonge v. Oregon, Edwards v. South Carolina, and Counterman v. Colorado, the article shows courts have consistently ruled that riots, intimidation, threats, property destruction, road blockages, and coercive conduct fall outside constitutional protection.

* **Lawlessness weakens liberty, not speech:** Using recent anti-ICE unrest in Minnesota as a case study, the author argues that excusing violence or obstruction as “protest” erodes the rule of law and endangers both public safety and legitimate First Amendment rights.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

__
[**Secure the High Ground: Truth Is Your Terrain**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 25** _Truth is not optional equipment. It’s foundational positioning. Before Scripture tells us what to do, it tells us where to stand. During the Gulf War, I was stationed at Büchel Air Base in Germany. We weren’t on the front lines—but we were deeply involved, flying missions into the combat zone, delivering critical loads, and returning home. What stayed with me then—and still does now—was the contrast in terrain._

[**Protests over ICE center in Hudson reveal liberal hypocrisy**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 23** _Hundreds gathered outside a dormant prison in tiny Hudson this week. They braved freezing cold to protest plans for a new ICE detention center. Signs demanded justice. CBS Colorado captured the scene. One organizer told reporters the facility would not protect or serve communities. A resident feared people packed like sardines in a can. Another warned expansion drives families into shadows and erodes trust._

Peter, My name is Alex Vindman, and after a lot of discussion, I have made the decision to run for Florida’s United States Senate seat. I hope you will give me a chance to explain — but if you already know the importance of winning in Florida, then I am asking you to chip in a Founding Donation to my campaign today. body:
We officially have a date for the vote on redistricting.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260127-76&t=1&akid=76%2E12592%2EFMNXCu)
It’s official:
**Virginia lawmakers have set April 21 as the most likely date for the redistricting vote.** _That gives us less than three months to inform voters, cut through right wing misinformation, and build the momentum needed to win._
Twelve weeks is not a lot of time, and we can’t afford to waste a single day.
Donald Trump and his allies will do everything they can to distort the truth about this crucial campaign — spreading confusion and trying to find new ways to rig congressional maps in favor of their own partisan political agenda.
**We cannot afford to let that happen.**
This temporary redistricting amendment isn’t about partisan games. It’s about protecting fair elections and representation for Virginians — full stop.
Over the next twelve weeks, Virginians for Fair Elections must reach voters in every corner of the Commonwealth with the facts: What this amendment does, why it matters, and how a YES vote protects voters’ voices in Washington.
That takes resources, and it’s why we’re asking now.
A contribution today helps us:
* Launch voter education before misinformation takes hold
* Fund rapid response as attacks ramp up
* Reach undecided voters who may only hear about this once

The clock is ticking and April 21 will be here before we know it.
[**Can you chip in right now to help us make the most of these next twelve weeks? Donate today to protect fair elections in Virginia and stop the GOP from rigging the midterms.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260127_1.dFQSkU&amount=3&refcode=20260127-76&t=2&akid=76%2E12592%2EFMNXCu)

name: Maxine Dexter
subject: Impeach Trump, Noem, and defund ICE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maxine for Congress
body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter,
Donald Trump’s ICE agents murdered another American in cold blood on Saturday.
Enough is enough. We must impeach Donald Trump, impeach Kristi Noem, and defund ICE.
If you agree, share your voice. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/V1_Vrl2xA0GcVVetz7usdg2]
SIGN ON TODAY [https://secure.ngpvan.com/V1_Vrl2xA0GcVVetz7usdg2]
In the last month, ICE agents shot two people in Portland. They used a five-year-old as bait. They detained an Oregon family seeking medical care for their daughter.
On January 8th, they shot and killed Renee Nicole Good.
On January 24th, they shot and killed Alex Jeffrey Pretti—without a warrant for his arrest and without a trial by jury.
Alex Pretti was a VA nurse and a U.S. citizen. He was standing up for his neighbors, holding a cellphone—not a gun—at a protest. And he was shot multiple times by federal officers. It’s sick and goes against every oath to defend and protect the Constitution and the American people.
At the scene, ICE agents prevented a physician from administering care, just like they did with Renee Good. And immediately after, the Trump administration started spreading misinformation and blatant lies about the killing, just like they did with Renee Good.
We cannot, and will not, stand for it. Last week, I voted against funding another cent to ICE and CBP. Now, the Senate faces the same decision.
Let’s make it clear that the ICE’s lawlessness and cruelty cannot stand.
The longer we allow Donald Trump’s forces to invade and occupy our cities, the worse this will become. The Trump administration and its paramilitary are not making our communities safer; instead, they’re endangering us all.
Not backing down,
Maxine

Now she's using those skills in Congress to ensure healthy communities by standing up to Big Pharma, fighting climate change, and expanding reproductive rights, as well as rebuilding a fair economy for all by protecting Social Security and Medicare.

Friends, this is really important:
ICE is not above the law. When federal agents abuse their authority or violate people’s rights, we will not look away, and we will not be silent.
Right now, the federal government is using terror and fear to try to suppress our freedoms.
Unmarked military-style vehicles and masked, armed agents.
Detainments that more closely resemble kidnappings.
The outright refusal to cooperate with investigations into the horrific and tragic killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.
Californians are rightly concerned by the prospect of federal agents crossing the line and abusing their authority.
The Trump administration wants us to ignore all of this, but California is doing the opposite: We launched a new online portal [https://oag.ca.gov/ReportMisconduct] to track misconduct by ICE, CBP, and other federal agents in California.
Federal agents do NOT have absolute immunity , so let there be no question: my office stands ready to conduct thorough, independent investigations into potential violations committed by federal agents. And when the facts warrant, we will not hesitate to file charges.
If you witness potential misconduct by federal agents in California, you can report it — because no one is above the law.
Visit oag.ca.gov/ReportMisconduct [http://oag.ca.gov/ReportMisconduct] .
California is paying attention.
—Rob

clean_body: We CAN win — but only if we organize. | These are three facts we know to be true, friends: FACT #1: Trump and his allies are actively marching us toward authoritarianism. FACT #2: They saw our wins last year — and they’re responding by throwing massive fossil fuel money at races, rigging congressional maps, and even launching a war for oil to distract from Trump’s disastrous leadership. His super PAC has even managed to raise $300 million ahead of the midterms. FACT #3: Our candidates running for the U.S. Senate, House of Representatives, and must-win state and local races rely on this grassroots team, the very people reading this email, to go toe-to-toe with Trump's billionaire backers and win. = | = Nobody should underestimate the power of early money. What we raise now, when the vast majority of people aren’t paying attention, is so important to our candidates’ ability to get their message out, introduce themselves to voters, and hire organizers to do the work that wins elections. And we’re relying on individuals like you to help us bring in more donations from Cresco to meet our goal before our first end-of-month deadline of 2026. Look, the grassroots organizing we do only works if people like you take action — folks who believe in this fight and understand the power of neighbors working together for clean air, clean water, and a future where our fundamental freedoms are protected. = = In solidarity, Team JanePAC | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
Pressure is building to bring the SAVE America Act to the U.S. Senate floor for a vote
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/0100019c01653990-fd0014c8-adc6-4072-a16e-06fe083e6388-000000/lYZeB8ZnV7J8dgH5GG5S2ZUQfbDQLspt1wiod1J77mc=442)Patriot–President Trump is calling on patriots across the nation to rally in support of the SAVE America Act to **secure our elections and ensure only U.S. citizens vote**.With your help, last week we added four new Republican co-sponsors bringing the total to 38 Republican U.S. Senators! Thanks go to Alabama Senator Katie Britt, Tennessee Senator Bill Hagerty, Indiana Senator Todd Young, and Pennsylvania Senator Dave McCormick for supporting the legislation.Let them know we appreciate their support [_**by posting a thank-you message on X**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fintent%2Fpost%3Ftext=%2540SenKatieBritt%2520%2540SenatorHagerty%2520%2540SenToddYoung%2520%2540SenMcCormickPA%2520thank%2520you%2520for%2520adding%2520your%2520names%2520to%2520U.S.%2520Senators%2520supporting%2520the%2520SAVE%2520Act%2520to%2520protect%2520our%2520elections%2520by%2520ensuring%2520only%2520citizens%2520vote.%26url=https%253A%252F%252Ftpp.me%252Fpassthesaveact/1/0100019c01653990-fd0014c8-adc6-4072-a16e-06fe083e6388-000000/x4dz06xzz08jbid6ge9VTurR1mPr9L6UicC4IAGVRgU=442).[THANK NEW CO-SPONSORS](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fintent%2Fpost%3Ftext=%2540SenKatieBritt%2520%2540SenatorHagerty%2520%2540SenToddYoung%2520%2540SenMcCormickPA%2520thank%2520you%2520for%2520adding%2520your%2520names%2520to%2520U.S.%2520Senators%2520supporting%2520the%2520SAVE%2520Act%2520to%2520protect%2520our%2520elections%2520by%2520ensuring%2520only%2520citizens%2520vote.%26url=https%253A%252F%252Ftpp.me%252Fpassthesaveact/2/0100019c01653990-fd0014c8-adc6-4072-a16e-06fe083e6388-000000/OD1ywX3uwgVlTr26FV_2Hd1p_ovaXgdATElk3Bz4JoI=442)If the link doesn't work on your device, you can copy and paste the following text into your post.

`@SenKatieBritt @SenatorHagerty @SenToddYoung @SenMcCormickPA thank you for adding your names to U.S. Senators supporting the SAVE Act to protect our elections by ensuring only citizens vote. https://tpp.me/passthesaveact`Your urging helped move these Senators to say **YES** to requiring proof of citizenship at voter registration, closing loopholes that currently allow noncitizens to register and vote.Progress was made, but right now the SAVE America Act is still languishing in the U.S. Senate.**You can help move more Senators to get this crucial legislation moving forward!** Voting is a **sacred American right** and we refuse to continue to let non-U.S. citizens dilute our votes.Contact these 13 GOP holdouts — urge them to co-sponsor the SAVE Act today!| **Sen. subject: Abolish ICE

body:
Officers need to be prosecuted, and we need to fix our broken immigration system.

| |
---
Friend, **We need to abolish ICE.** The violence and mayhem they are committing around the country show that ICE is beyond repair. But here's the thing: abolishing ICE is not enough. Democrats need an actual plan for what’s next to fix our broken immigration system. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124156739/597733153/1733122168?refcode=260127_sm_abolish&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzU4M2VlOS1jYWZiLWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RnFKZPv1aoWs6O6tDT0rLF6smAmLC4E75AbWjb6Suhw=&emci=1f583ee9-cafb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=27583ee9-cafb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=194769) Donald Trump has turned ICE agents into his own personal enforcers of our broken and racist immigration system. The entire machine needs to be dismantled and rebuilt, with consequences for those who have violated Americans’ rights while hiding behind a mask. Here's what we need to do:
1. Abolish ICE
2. Prosecute the ICE and CBP officers who murdered American citizens and violated constitutional rights
3. Build a comprehensive and humane immigration system that incentivizes people to come here legally instead of illegally, provides a clear pathway to citizenship, and is supported by an enforcement system that reflects American values in every action and policy

# Did you know?

**Tabulator tapes** serve as the "cash register receipts" of an election, providing a physical record of every vote scanned by a specific machine. According to **Georgia State Rule 183-1-12-.12** , these tapes must be printed in triplicate and signed by a poll manager and two witnesses to legally certify the results and establish a secure chain of custody. When these tapes go unsigned—as seen with the **315,000 ballots** in Fulton County—the legal link between the machine’s digital count and the final certification is severed. Without these signatures, there is no verified proof that the results were observed and found accurate at the source, transforming a foundational security requirement into an unverified "clerical error" and leaving the entire election outcome vulnerable to a lack of accountability.
---
|
---
---
| |
# Back on the trail...
Welcome to 2026! I hope you and your families stayed safe and warm during the recent winter storms. While the ice may have slowed down the morning commute for some, it certainly didn’t slow down our momentum. After a brief winter break to recharge over the holidays, our team is officially back on the trail and more energized than ever. This year is pivotal. We aren’t just running a campaign; we are building a movement to restore integrity, accountability, and common-sense solutions to our Secretary of State's office.

# Supporting Senate Resolution 563

Election integrity isn't just a slogan—it’s the bedrock of our republic and our duty as citizens of this great country. Our republic depends on all of us to serve as the final auditor of our elections.
As we begin this new year, I want to reiterate my unwavering support for Senate Resolution 563.
I stand firmly with our Georgia Senators in calling on the current Secretary of State to fully comply with the Department of Justice’s requests. Bloated voter rolls are unacceptable and a threat to the security and transparency of our elections.
For too long, the current administration has relied on talking points rather than transparency. I recently shared my thoughts on this, and the message remains the same:
_"If our voter rolls are truly ‘the cleanest in the nation,’ now is the time to prove it—through transparency and action, not rhetoric. I urge members of the House to do the same."_
The voters of Georgia deserve a Secretary of State who welcomes accountability instead of obstructing it. We cannot restore trust in our system if the office in charge of it continues to push back against legitimate oversight.
It is time to stop the excuses and start the work of securing our elections.

body:
[](https://karlforcongress.us/updates/be3986d5/)
---
Since the beginning of 2026, we have witnessed the continued and expanding terrorization of U.S. cities by the federal government, resulting in the deaths of nine people at the hands of ICE and other agencies under DHS. This follows, and is currently outpacing, 2025, [which was ICE's deadliest year](https://link.karlforcongress.us/69791554/ "2025 was ICE’s deadliest year in two decades. Here are the 32 people who died in custody") on record. This year, things have come to a head as we have all witnessed the [execution-style killings of American citizens](https://link.karlforcongress.us/6979248e/ "National Guard activated in Minneapolis after Border Patrol agent kills man") in our streets. These tragedies have been followed by [baffling defenses](https://link.karlforcongress.us/697921cd/ "Trump connects latest Minneapolis shooting with ‘cover up’ for ‘theft and fraud’ in state ") of the officers' actions and blatant lies by this administration, despite each incident being captured on numerous cameras for the world to see. We should all shudder to think how they lie when the cameras aren't there. In our democracy, the government derives its powers from the consent of the governed. Similarly, to effectively police a population, an agency must have the consent of the policed. These institutions are granted authority and latitude far beyond that of a regular citizen because their presence is deemed necessary; however, with that power comes a higher standard of responsibility and accountability. Policing requires a foundation of trust. ICE has shattered that trust. Their actions, and the subsequent cover-ups bolstered by this administration, have rendered that relationship irreparable. Because they can no longer operate effectively in our communities and with our trust, **ICE must be abolished**.

These last few days have been a gut-wrenching reminder of how dangerous the Trump Administration has become. The events that occurred in Minnesota should have never been allowed to happen.

It’s why I was proud to vote against the additional funding for ICE when it came to a vote in the House. Under Trump and Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem’s direction, innocent people have been put at risk in the name of law and order.

When I meet with folks across CA-27, it’s clear that our communities are scared. I believe that public safety cannot exist without accountability -- and have called for a local investigation into the events in Minneapolis.

It’s another reminder of just how much is at stake in November. Americans cannot continue to live in fear for themselves and their neighbors.

I’ll continue to push forward for change from my position in Congress. I hope you’re with me in these next few months, and the battle for control of the House majority -- something that is necessary for more accountability.

Thank you,

George

subject: Rethink what healthy means

Why strength and muscle are finally getting their due | Friends,

America is entering a new chapter in how we think about food and health.

With the release of the new federal nutrition guidelines, there’s growing recognition that the old model of counting calories, fearing protein, and chasing food trends has failed too many people.

What’s been missing from this conversation is muscle.

**Muscle isn’t just about strength or appearance. It’s the foundation of metabolic health, resilience as we age, and long-term independence.** And yet for decades, it’s been overlooked in our national approach to nutrition and wellness.

_That’s why I wrote The Forever Strong Playbook._

[ ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d2ea5c0943c14d539bb7ef6e753f0dde&_e=GxFnEsbr4PvTWLVQFC3DfIpVyrj7CRFZyHwmtBIbGhBlC9_2nHXNXrWBuqX-y6edvJhmi2luojDHEJi7g_4rmpVF_xpCnvNRIdgt_QNRHyCzAJIGzI9SqwiNuvm26kDI1RFrcaSD9NPbZKeZWs9JWrpIXP-IaaBKV1LSIE_74OZ4PP9j3Ssrz42gKjvqkPzSD0rdquwVCXZDZAh2lVKLosg9B1AQnpvsnh9p_RnsPeNJF8Rv3s65qtlQik4NDrSBKJanxGw9uzPUMJe4ORwJpg-QJTJnyPNbKt26GiGdUDPdOqV1K6jsgRGgM3bm9S6N3ZtLSkYhYNdICGosVk7eemRFQNKDhKMRsL6pPeKlBcs%3D)

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2601-q1-ak [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2601-q1-ak]Hey team, I have a quick story to tell you.
Last week, I attended an event with a respected former government official who spent more than 30 years working on public lands here in Colorado, and you know what stuck out? They had never even heard of Jeff Hurd’s Productive Public Lands Act (PPLA).
That says a lot.
Most Coloradans care deeply about our public lands, from recreation and wildlife habitat to the economies of communities across the West. Yet information about this bill simply isn’t reaching people who work in these spaces every day.
Hurd’s Productive Public Lands Act (H.R. 1997) would require the BLM to reissue several previously finalized Resource Management Plans, effectively reversing multiple Biden-era plans and reopening millions of acres for expanded uses like mining, drilling, and timber harvesting.
Coloradans deserve to know what our representatives stand for and how proposed legislation could impact working lands, wildlife habitat, and access for all Coloradans. If you agree with me, please give $10 or more to support my campaign: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2601-q1-ak?amount=10]

We’ve all seen the images over the past month out of Minnesota. An innocent mother and an ICU nurse, both shot and killed at nearly point-blank range. ICE and other DHS forces under the control of Trump have shot 12 people since November. Dozens more have died in DHS detention facilities since last year. **This is all the predictable result of a Congress that keeps expanding the power of ICE and other agencies to operate with impunity.** Just last week, _seven_ House Democrats joined Republicans to pass a funding bill that would send billions more to the same agencies that are now roaming our streets, shooting and killing people. **Too many Democrats in Congress have****not****been meeting this moment. clean_body: | | | Peter, We’ve all seen the images over the past month out of Minnesota. An innocent mother and an ICU nurse, both shot and killed at nearly point-blank range. Masked, lawless thugs threatening anyone they happen to come across, breaking into homes and cars. These were not isolated tragedies. ICE and other DHS forces under the control of Trump have shot 12 people since November. Dozens more have died in DHS detention facilities since last year. This is all the predictable result of a Congress that keeps expanding the power of ICE and other agencies to operate with impunity. Just last week, seven House Democrats joined Republicans to pass a funding bill that would send billions more to the same agencies that are now roaming our streets, shooting and killing people. Too many Democrats in Congress havenotbeen meeting this moment. But next week, for the first time in 2026, voters have a chance to send a leader to Congress whowill. WFP champion Analilia Mejia is running in the first Congressional special election of the year in New Jersey’s 11th district, and her primary is next Thursday, February 5th. Electing her would send a powerful message that we expect our leaders to say NO to Trump’s agenda, NO to ICE’s reign of terror, and YES to a government that shows the same courage that working people everywhere are showing in this moment. Analilia is a longtime labor and immigrant-justice organizer who has spent decades standing with working families, not billionaires or corporate PACs. She led the Working Families Party for years in New Jersey, helping to lead and win fights for a $15 minimum wage and paid sick time. She’s helped train residents on how to safely and effectively respond to ICE’s violence, and called for an end to ICE as an agency. And she has been endorsed by champions including Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Bernie Sanders, Ayanna Pressley, and Maxwell Frost. This is our first chance in 2026 to elect a leader to Congress who will actually show up for working people instead of enabling more harm against them. But time is running short to make an impact and reach more voters. Help elect Analilia Mejia before her primary on February 5th: In solidarity and resistance, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. | | | | Exclusive message from Marsha Blackburn for TOP supporters ONLY:Hi, Peter,
It’s Marsha Blackburn, and I personally wanted to reach out to you today to say THANK YOU. As I sit down to write this email, I'm filled with gratitude. I am thinking about all the fantastic supporters like you who've stood by me every step of the way.
You have always been such an incredible supporter of me and my cause, and you deserve recognition. From the bottom of my heart, I am truly grateful for you and wanted to make sure you knew.
Your unwavering commitment to our shared values and your trust in me to fight for them in Washington are what fuel my passion and drive me to keep pushing forward.

Through it all, you've been a rock, a true champion of our cause, and I'm honored to have you by my side.
As we look to the future, I know that the road ahead won't be easy. The forces of liberalism and socialism will stop at nothing to undermine our progress and push their radical agenda. [But I know that with supporters like you, we can overcome any obstacle and achieve great things.](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn._LOcZKGga4t5XiisNC1g)
That's why I'm counting on you to continue standing with me in this fight. Your support is crucial to our success, and I'm asking you to pitch in today to help us keep pushing forward.
Every dollar counts! Your support will help us take on the tough battles ahead and emerge victorious.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: Here’s why I’m in this fight:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
This is deeply personal to me.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=4802%2E582294%2EHE6flb)
I’m going to share more about why I’m running for U.S. Senate, but if you’re already on board, **[please chip in $5 now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260127_3.O2k5Ri&refcode=em20260127-3&t=2&akid=4802%2E582294%2EHE6flb)**
I’m running for Senate because at this pivotal moment, our economy, our democracy, and our way of life are on the line. New Hampshire deserves a Senator who is grounded in the people, places, and values of this state -- and one who is ready to lead on day one.
Our country is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will have generational impacts. You can count on me to continue taking on big fights and to confront the Trump Administration, self-dealing billionaires, and extreme politicians who are threatening our future and our ability to get things done for New Hampshire.
**[Can I count on you to back my campaign with a $5 contribution right now? We can’t win this race without major grassroots support.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260127_3.O2k5Ri&refcode=em20260127-3&t=3&akid=4802%2E582294%2EHE6flb)**
**These fights are deeply personal to me.** My family immigrated from Greece and opened a restaurant in Manchester 108 years ago, a small business that remains at the heart of the community today. Running that small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others, but the opportunity that my ancestors and so many others like them sought has never been further away -- and the Trump Administration is too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn.
I’m also happily married to my husband, Vann. With the current wave of hateful policies leveled at the LGBTQ+ community, I know how important representation is at this moment. **If elected, I’d be the first out gay male U.S. Senator in history** -- a badge of honor I’d wear proudly as I advocate for full equality.
I am the proud product of public education, and I come from a family of business owners _(my grandfather invented the chicken tender at the restaurant — seriously!)_. I understand firsthand the need to support neighborhood schools and small businesses in our community. **These are the lifeblood of our economy and the pillars of opportunity for everyone.**
My life experiences are what led me to successfully run for four terms in Congress and win in one of the “swingiest” districts in the nation. Before I won my election in 2018, no one had managed to hold the seat for more than one term for more than a decade. I’m no stranger to tough electoral fights. **Now I’m ready to take on the fight to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue.**
We can’t afford to sit on the sidelines of the big fights ahead -- not with so much at stake, from the rising costs debilitating working families to the threats to the future of our democracy. We’ve taken on big fights together in Congress. Now it’s time to win this critical Senate seat so we can keep standing up to the Trump Administration and the self-dealing billionaires threatening our future. Can I count on you to join the fight?
**[If you’re with me, let’s make a powerful statement together and prove that we’re ready to win this race. Show your support with a $5 donation now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260127_3.O2k5Ri&refcode=em20260127-3&t=4&akid=4802%2E582294%2EHE6flb)**

I’m going to share more about why I’m running for U.S. Senate, but if you’re already on board, I’m running for Senate because at this pivotal moment, our economy, our democracy, and our way of life are on the line. New Hampshire deserves a Senator who is grounded in the people, places, and values of this state -- and one who is ready to lead on day one. Our country is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will have generational impacts. You can count on me to continue taking on big fights and to confront the Trump Administration, self-dealing billionaires, and extreme politicians who are threatening our future and our ability to get things done for New Hampshire. These fights are deeply personal to me. My family immigrated from Greece and opened a restaurant in Manchester 108 years ago, a small business that remains at the heart of the community today. Running that small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others, but the opportunity that my ancestors and so many others like them sought has never been further away -- and the Trump Administration is too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn. I’m also happily married to my husband, Vann. With the current wave of hateful policies leveled at the LGBTQ+ community, I know how important representation is at this moment. If elected, I’d be the first out gay male U.S. Senator in history -- a badge of honor I’d wear proudly as I advocate for full equality. I am the proud product of public education, and I come from a family of business owners (my grandfather invented the chicken tender at the restaurant — seriously!). I understand firsthand the need to support neighborhood schools and small businesses in our community. These are the lifeblood of our economy and the pillars of opportunity for everyone. My life experiences are what led me to successfully run for four terms in Congress and win in one of the “swingiest” districts in the nation. Before I won my election in 2018, no one had managed to hold the seat for more than one term for more than a decade. I’m no stranger to tough electoral fights. Now I’m ready to take on the fight to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue. I’ve heard overwhelmingly from supporters, constituents, and voters at this difficult moment for our country, so I wanted to make sure you heard this statement from me directly:

**I cannot and will not vote to fund the Department of Homeland Security while this administration continues these violent federal takeovers of our cities.**

President Trump’s endless empowerment of federal immigration agents has resulted in yet another senseless killing. Renee Good and Alex Pretti should both still be with us today.

**We cannot continue down this path. Our country is better than this.**

Without the majority in Congress, withholding funding for the DHS is one of the few levers Democrats in the Senate have to demand further guardrails at this moment. But the reality is, the best way to hold Trump and this administration accountable is to flip the balance of power in Congress this year.

_I will continue to work for transparency and accountability in Washington – while fighting like hell to hold this critical seat and elect Democrats across Virginia so we can flip the House and the Senate in November._

Please know how grateful I am to have you in this fight with me.

Keep speaking up. Your voice is making a difference.

The fight continues,

She’s ignored the law, violated her oath, and let ICE agents violently disrupt our communities.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124160135/597744522/-153530995?refcode=EM_C_260127impeach_N_SB_90DO_5_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGNiMWRlYS1kM2ZiLWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5F8DEQo9R8MthmPiJrhElOOl6p7U8WS-jwtBRqEGNUs=) Peter,

Last week, I voted NO on legislation to fund the rogue and violent agency, ICE, along with the US Customs and Border Protection. **I refuse to support a single cent going to an agency that is blatantly terrorizing and abusing our communities.**

And I’m not stopping there: **I am proud to have co-sponsored articles of impeachment against DHS Secretary Kristi Noem to remove her from office for good.**

Noem has repeatedly failed the American people, violated her oath, and let ICE agents get away with making our communities less safe. Just this month alone, we witnessed ICE agents take the lives of Renee Good and Alex Pretti. Instead of Noem holding herself accountable and halting ICE’s illegal actions, she has BLOCKED oversight while the Trump administration went straight to lying and slander.

**We are seeing with our own eyes what’s happening in this country, and it’s despicable. Under Noem’s leadership, our nation is in a public safety and moral crisis.**

Every day, ICE and CBP are committing unthinkable abuses with zero accountability, no respect for the law, and a complete disregard for civil rights. Meanwhile, the administration is bending over backward to justify its actions and block justice.

It’s time for it to end.

In solidarity,

Peter, these
are accounts from Minnesota in the days since the murders of Renee Good
and Alex Pretti. Please read on.

ICE agents at a Target in Richfield, Minnesota grabbed a teenage employee
who was heckling them — as is your legal right — and threw him to the
ground. They shoved him in a van and drove away.

The boy was an American citizen who was yelling that he had his passport
in his pocket. They didn’t listen until he was detained. Since they had no
authority to arrest him, agents dumped him in a Walmart parking lot down
the road with no way to get home. He was found injured, bleeding, and
crying for help. A child.

employee who was heckling them — as is your legal right — and threw him to
the ground.

Christian Molina, a Latino man and US citizen, was driving to work in
South Minneapolis when ICE agents crashed into his car to force him to
stop. Why? Because he looked “illegal.” Christian refused to cooperate
with the illegal stop. When neighbors came to the scene to observe and
support, ICE tear gassed the crowd and left.

dragged him away to an unmarked van. Arrested for exercising his First
